title.la: Utrum dona sint necessaria homini ad salutem
title.zh: 恩賜為人之得救是否必要

title.la: Utrum dona Spiritus Sancti sint habitus
title.zh: 聖神之恩賜是否為習性

title.la: Utrum convenienter septem dona Spiritus Sancti enumerentur
title.zh: 七種聖神恩賜之數目是否正確

title.la: Utrum dona Spiritus Sancti sint connexa
title.zh: 聖神之恩賜彼此是否有聯繫

title.la: Utrum dona spiritus sancti maneant in patria
title.zh: 在天鄉是否留存聖神的恩賜

title.la: Utrum dignitas donorum attenditur secundum enumerationem qua enumerantur Isaiae XI
title.zh: 恩賜之等級是否按〈依撒意亞〉的排列

title.la: Utrum virtutes sint praeferendae donis
title.zh: 德性是否優於恩賜

title.la: De beatitudinibus
title.zh: 論真福

title.la: Utrum beatitudines a virtutibus et donis distinguantur
title.zh: 真褔與德性及恩賜是否有區別

title.la: Utrum praemia quae attribuuntur beatitudinibus pertineant ad hanc vitam
title.zh: 真褔所指之賞報是否屬於現世

title.la: Utrum convenienter enumerentur beatitudines
title.zh: 真福之數目是否正確

title.la: Utrum praemia beatitudinum convenienter enumerentur
title.zh: 各真福之賞報是否適當

title.la: De fructibus Spiritus Sancti
title.zh: 論聖神之果實

title.la: Utrum fructus spiritus sancti quos Apostolus nominat ad Galat. V, sint actus
title.zh: 聖神之果實是否為行動

title.la: Utrum fructus a beatitudinibus differant
title.zh: 聖神的果實與真福有無區別

title.la: Utrum Apostolus convenienter enumeret, ad Galat. V, duodecim fructus
title.zh: 宗徒所列之果實是否正確

title.la: Utrum fructus Sanctus Spiriti contrarientur operibus carnis
title.zh: 聖神之果實是否與肉軀之私慾的作用相反

title.la: De vitiis et peccatis secundum se
title.zh: 論惡習及罪過本身

title.la: Utrum vitium contrarietur virtuti
title.zh: 惡習是否與德性相反

title.la: Utrum vitium sit contra naturam
title.zh: 惡習是否與天性相反

title.la: Utrum vitium sit peius quam peccatum
title.zh: 惡習是否比惡行更壞

title.la: Utrum actus vitiosus, sive peccatum, possit simul esse cum virtute
title.zh: 罪過能否與德、性並存

title.la: Utrum in quolibet peccato sit aliquis actus
title.zh: 罪過是否必有行動

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter definiatur peccatum, cum dicitur, peccatum est dictum vel factum vel concupitum contra legem aeternam
title.zh: 將罪過定義為「這反永恆法律的慾念及言行」'是否合適

title.la: De distinctione peccatorum
title.zh: 論罪惡之分類

title.la: Utrum peccata differant specie secundum obiecta
title.zh: 罪過是否按對象分類

title.la: Utrum convenienter distinguantur peccata spiritualia a carnalibus
title.zh: 將罪過分為精神性的和肉慾性的是否適當

title.la: Utrum peccata distinguantur specie secundum causas
title.zh: 罪過是否按原因分類

title.la: Utrum convenienter peccatum distinguatur per peccatum quod est in Deum, in proximum, et in seipsum
title.zh: 將罪過分為對天主的、對自己的和對他人的，是否合理

title.la: Utrum divisio peccatorum quae est secundum reatum, diversificet speciem
title.zh: 罪過按處罰的區分是否構成不同的類別

title.la: Utrum peccatum commissionis et omissionis specie differant
title.zh: 妄動與曠職之罪是否不同類別

title.la: Utrum convenienter dividatur peccatum in peccatum cordis, oris, et operis
title.zh: 將罪過分為心思的、口舌的和行為的，是否合適

title.la: Utrum superabundantia et defectus diversificent species peccatorum
title.zh: 過與不及是否構成罪過之不同的類別

title.la: Utrum vitia et peccata diversificentur specie secundum diversas circumstantias
title.zh: 罪過是否因情況不同而分類

title.la: De comparatione peccatorum ad invicem
title.zh: 論罪過彼此之比較

title.la: Utrum omnia peccata sint connexa
title.zh: 罪過是否皆相牽連

title.la: Utrum omnia peccata sint paria
title.zh: 罪過是否皆相等

title.la: Utrum peccatorum gravitas varietur secundum obiecta
title.zh: 罪過之輕重是否因對象而異

title.la: Utrum gravitas peccatorum differat secundum dignitatem virtutum quibus peccata opponuntur
title.zh: 罪過之輕重是否因其所反對之德性的高低而異

title.la: Utrum peccata carnalia sint minoris culpae quam peccata spiritualia
title.zh: 肉慾方面的罪過是否比精神方面的罪過輕

title.la: Utrum gravitas peccatorum attendatur secundum causam peccati
title.zh: 罪過之輕重是否看罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum circumstantia aggravet peccatum
title.zh: 情況是否加重罪過

title.la: Utrum gravitas peccati augeatur secundum maius nocumentum
title.zh: 罪過是否囡害處大而加重

title.la: Utrum propter conditionem personae in quam peccatur, peccatum aggravetur
title.zh: 罪過是否因所冒犯者之身分而加重

title.la: Utrum magnitudo personae peccantis aggravet peccatum
title.zh: 犯罪者的優異是否加重罪過

title.la: De subiecto peccatorum
title.zh: 論罪過之主體

title.la: Utrum voluntas possit esse subiectum peccati
title.zh: 意志是否為罪過之主體

title.la: Utrum sola voluntas sit subiectum peccati
title.zh: 是否只有意志為罪過之主體

title.la: Utrum in sensualitate possit esse peccatum
title.zh: 感官嗜慾是否能有罪

title.la: Utrum in sensualitate possit esse peccatum mortale
title.zh: 在感官嗜慾上是否能有死罪

title.la: Utrum peccatum possit esse in ratione
title.zh: 理性上是否能有罪過

title.la: Utrum peccatum morosae delectationis sit in ratione
title.zh: 理性上是否有姑息性快樂之罪過

title.la: Utrum peccatum consensus in actum sit in ratione superiori
title.zh: 同意行動之罪過是否在高級理性

title.la: Utrum consensus in delectationem sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 同意於快樂是否為死罪

title.la: Utrum in superiori ratione possit esse peccatum veniale, secundum quod est directiva inferiorum virium
title.zh: 就其指導低級能力而言，高級理性是否能有小罪

title.la: Utrum in superiori ratione possit esse peccatum veniale secundum seipsam
title.zh: 高級理性在本身方面是否能有小罪

title.la: De causis peccatorum
title.zh: 泛論罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum peccatum habeat causam
title.zh: 罪過是否有原因

title.la: Utrum peccatum habeat causam interiorem
title.zh: 罪過是否有內在之原因

title.la: Utrum peccatum habeat causam exteriorem
title.zh: 罪過是否有外在之原因

title.la: Utrum peccatum sit causa peccati
title.zh: 罪過是否為罪過之原因

title.la: De causis peccati in speciali
title.zh: 論罪過之個別原因

title.la: Utrum ignorantia possit esse causa peccati
title.zh: 愚昧是否能為罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum ignorantia sit peccatum
title.zh: 愚昧是否為罪過

title.la: Utrum ignorantia, ex toto excuset a peccato
title.zh: 愚昧是否完全免除罪過

title.la: Utrum ignorantia diminuat peccatum
title.zh: 愚昧是否減輕罪過

title.la: De causa peccati ex parte appetitus sensitivi
title.zh: 論罪過在感官嗜慾方面的原因

title.la: Utrum voluntas moveatur a passione appetitus sensitivi
title.zh: 意志是否受感官嗜慾之惰的推動

title.la: Utrum ratio possit superari a passione contra suam scientiam
title.zh: 理性能否為情所勝而背叛其知識

title.la: Utrum peccatum quod est ex passione, debeat dici ex infirmitate
title.zh: 由情而來之罪過是否應稱為由軟弱而來之罪過

title.la: Utrum amor sui sit principium omnis peccati
title.zh: 愛己之情是否為一切罪過之根源

title.la: Utrum convenienter ponantur causae peccatorum esse concupiscentia carnis, concupiscentia oculorum, et superbia vitae
title.zh: 是否可以說「肉身的貪慾~UN目的貪慾，以及人生的驕奢」是罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum peccatum allevietur propter passionem
title.zh: 情是否減輕罪過

title.la: Utrum passio totaliter excuset a peccato
title.zh: 情是否完全脫除罪過

title.la: Utrum peccatum quod est ex passione possit esse mortale
title.zh: 由情而來之罪過是否能為死罪

title.la: De causa peccati quae dicitur malitia
title.zh: 論惡意位罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum aliquis peccet ex industria, sive ex certa malitia
title.zh: 是否有人由於惡意而犯罪

title.la: Utrum omnis qui peccat ex habitu, peccet ex certa malitia
title.zh: 由於習性而犯罪者，是否是由於惡意而犯罪

title.la: Utrum quicumque peccat ex certa malitia, peccet ex habitu
title.zh: 由於惡意而犯罪者，是否是由於習性而犯罪

title.la: Utrum ille qui peccat ex certa malitia, peccet gravius quam ille qui peccat ex passione
title.zh: 由於惡意而犯罪者，其罪是否重於由於情而犯罪者

title.la: De causis exterioribus peccati
title.zh: 論罪過之外在原因：首論天主方面的原因

title.la: Utrum Deus sit causa peccati
title.zh: 天主是否為罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum actus peccati sit a Deo
title.zh: 罪過之行動是否來白天主

title.la: Utrum Deus sit causa excaecationis et indurationis
title.zh: 天主是否為昏昧及心硬之原因

title.la: Utrum excaecatio et obduratio semper ordinentur ad salutem eius qui excaecatur et obduratur
title.zh: 昏昧與心硬是否常有益於本人之得救

title.la: De causa peccati ex parte diaboli
title.zh: 論魔鬼方面的罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum diabolus sit homini directe causa peccandi
title.zh: 魔鬼是否直接為人犯罪的原因

title.la: Utrum diabolus possit inducere ad peccandum interius instigando
title.zh: 魔鬼是否能在內部挑動人犯罪

title.la: Utrum diabolus possit necessitatem inferre ad peccandum
title.zh: 魔鬼是否能強迫人犯罪

title.la: Utrum omnia peccata hominum sint ex suggestione diaboli
title.zh: 是否所有罪過皆來自魔鬼的挑動

title.la: De causa peccati ex parte hominis
title.zh: 論在人方面的罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum primum peccatum primi parentis traducatur ad alios per originem
title.zh: 原祖之第一個罪是否以出生關係流傳給後代

title.la: Utrum etiam alia peccata vel ipsius primi parentis, vel proximorum parentum, traducantur in posteros
title.zh: 原祖或別的祖先的其他罪過，是否傳給後代子孫

title.la: Utrum peccatum primi parentis transeat per originem in omnes homines
title.zh: 原祖的罪是否因血統關係傳給所有的人

title.la: Utrum si aliquis formaretur ex carne humana miraculose, contraheret originale peccatum
title.zh: 若以奇蹟用人之肉身形成人，是否也染有原罪

title.la: Utrum si Adam peccasset, Eva peccante, filii originale peccatum contraherent
title.zh: 若厄娃犯罪而亞當不犯罪，後代子孫是否會染原罪

title.la: De peccato originali quantum ad suam essentiam
title.zh: 論原罪之本質

title.la: Utrum originale peccatum sit habitus
title.zh: 原罪是否為習性

title.la: Utrum in uno homine sint multa originalia peccata
title.zh: 在一人身上是否有許多原罪

title.la: Utrum peccatum originale sit concupiscentia
title.zh: 原罪是否為不當慾望或貪慾

title.la: Utrum peccatum originale sit aequaliter in omnibus
title.zh: 是否每人的原罪皆相等

title.la: De subiecto originalis peccati
title.zh: 論原罪之主體

title.la: Utrum peccatum originale magis sit in carne quam in anima
title.zh: 原罪是否主要是在肉身上，而不是在靈魂上

title.la: Utrum peccatum originale sit per prius in essentia animae quam in potentiis
title.zh: 原罪是否首先在靈魂之本體上，而非在其機能上

title.la: Utrum peccatum originale per prius inficiat voluntatem quam alias potentias
title.zh: 原罪是否污染意志先於其他機能

title.la: Utrum praedictae potentiae sint magis infectae quam aliae
title.zh: 上述機能是否比其他機能受的污染更重

title.la: De causa peccati
title.zh: 就一罪爲另一罪之原因論罪過之原因

title.la: Utrum cupiditas sit radix omnium peccatorum
title.zh: 貪婪是否為一切罪過之根源

title.la: Utrum superbia sit initium omnis peccati
title.zh: 驕傲是否為一切罪過之開端

title.la: Utrum praeter superbiam et avaritiam, sint quaedam alia peccata specialia quae dicantur capitalia
title.zh: 除了驕傲和吝窗外，是否有其他個別罪惡應被視為罪宗

title.la: Utrum sit dicendum septem esse vitia capitalia, quae sunt inanis gloria, invidia, ira, tristitia, avaritia, gula, luxuria
title.zh: 罪宗列為七個是否合理

title.la: De effectibus peccati
title.zh: 論罪過之效果：首論對天性之善的破壞

title.la: Utrum peccatum diminuat bonum naturae
title.zh: 罪過是否減少天性之善

title.la: Utrum totum bonum humanae naturae possit per peccatum auferri
title.zh: 人性之善是否能全部被罪過消滅

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter ponantur vulnera naturae esse, ex peccato consequentia, infirmitas, ignorantia, malitia et concupiscentia
title.zh: 將軟弱、愚昧、惡意和貪慾視為罪過加給天性的創傷，是否合宜

title.la: Utrum privatio modi, speciei et ordinis, sit effectus peccati
title.zh: 狀態、美麗及次序之缺欠，是否為罪過之效果

title.la: Utrum mors et alii corporales defectus sint effectus peccati
title.zh: 死亡及身體上的其他缺點是否為罪過之效果

title.la: Utrum mors et huiusmodi defectus sint homini naturales
title.zh: 死亡及其他缺點對人是否為自然的

title.la: De macula peccati
title.zh: 論罪過之污染

title.la: Utrum peccatum causet aliquam maculam in anima
title.zh: 罪過是否在靈魂上產生污點

title.la: Utrum macula maneat in anima post actum peccati
title.zh: 犯罪行為過後污點是否仍然存留在靈魂上

title.la: De reatu poenae
title.zh: 論應受之處罰

title.la: Utrum reatus poenae sit effectus peccati
title.zh: 應受之處罰是否為罪過之效果

title.la: Utrum peccatum possit esse poena peccati
title.zh: 罪過是否能為罪過之處罰

title.la: Utrum aliquod peccatum inducat reatum aeternae poenae
title.zh: 是否有的罪過應受永罰

title.la: Utrum peccato debeatur poena infinita secundum quantitatem
title.zh: 是否有的罪過應受無限量的處罰

title.la: Utrum omne peccatum inducat reatum poenae aeternae
title.zh: 罪過是否皆應受永遠之處罰

title.la: Utrum reatus poenae remaneat post peccatum
title.zh: 解除罪過後是否仍留有處罰

title.la: Utrum omnis poena sit propter aliquam culpam
title.zh: 處罰是否皆是因了罪過

title.la: Utrum aliquis puniatur pro peccato alterius
title.zh: 人是否能因了他人的罪過受罰

title.la: De peccatis venialis et mortalis
title.zh: 論小罪和死罪

title.la: Utrum veniale peccatum convenienter dividatur contra mortale
title.zh: 區分小罪與死罪是否相宜

title.la: Utrum peccatum veniale et mortale differant genere
title.zh: 死罪與小罪是否有本類上的差別

title.la: Utrum peccatum veniale sit dispositio ad mortale
title.zh: 小罪是否為死罪之準備

title.la: Utrum peccatum veniale possit fieri mortale
title.zh: 小罪是否能變成死罪

title.la: Utrum circumstantia possit de veniali peccato facere mortale
title.zh: 情況是否能使小罪變為死罪

title.la: Utrum peccatum mortale possit fieri veniale
title.zh: 死罪是否能變成小罪

title.la: De peccato veniali secundum se
title.zh: 論小罪本身

title.la: Utrum peccatum veniale causet maculam in anima
title.zh: 小罪是否使靈魂有污點

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter peccata venialia per lignum, faenum et stipulam designentur
title.zh: 用木、草、禾稽來指小罪是否合理

title.la: Utrum homo in statu innocentiae potuerit peccare venialiter
title.zh: 人在純真狀態時是否能犯小罪

title.la: Utrum angelus bonus vel malus possit peccare venialiter
title.zh: 善的或惡的天使是否能犯小罪

title.la: Utrum primi motus sensualitatis in infidelibus sint peccata mortalia
title.zh: 教外人感官嗜慾的原始衝動是否為死罪

title.la: Utrum peccatum veniale possit esse in aliquo cum solo originali
title.zh: 是否有人只有原罪和小罪

title.la: De essentia legis
title.zh: 論法律之本質

title.la: Utrum lex sit aliquid rationis
title.zh: 法律是否屬於理性

title.la: Utrum lex ordinetur semper ad bonum commune sicut ad finem
title.zh: 法律是否常指向公益

title.la: Utrum cuiuslibet ratio sit factiva legis
title.zh: 私人之理性是否能構成法律

title.la: Utrum promulgatio sit de ratione legis
title.zh: 頒布是否為法律之要素

title.la: De diversitate legum
title.zh: 論法律之區分

title.la: Utrum sit aliqua lex aeterna
title.zh: 是否有永恆，之法律

title.la: Utrum sit in nobis aliqua lex naturalis
title.zh: 在我們內是否有自然法律

title.la: Utrum sit aliqua lex humana
title.zh: 是否有人為之法律

title.la: Utrum fuerit necessarium esse aliquam legem divinam
title.zh: 是否必該有天主的法律

title.la: Utrum lex divina sit una tantum
title.zh: 天主的法律是否只有一種

title.la: Utrum sit aliqua lex fomitis
title.zh: 是否有慾火之法律

title.la: De effectibus legis
title.zh: 論法律之效果

title.la: Utrum legis sit facere homines bonos
title.zh: 使人成為善人是否為法律之效果

title.la: Utrum legis actus sint convenienter assignati in hoc quod dicitur quod legis actus est imperare, vetare, permittere et punire
title.zh: 所列之法律作用是否合適

title.la: De lege aeterna
title.zh: 論永恆的法律

title.la: Utrum lex aeterna sit ratio summa in Deo existens
title.zh: 永恆的法律是否為天主內的最高之理

title.la: Utrum lex aeterna sit omnibus nota
title.zh: 永恆的法律是否為人所共知

title.la: Utrum omnis lex a lege aeterna derivetur
title.zh: 是否凡法律皆由永恆之法律而來

title.la: Utrum necessaria et aeterna subiiciantur legi aeternae
title.zh: 必然和永恆的事物是否屬於永恆的法律之下

title.la: Utrum naturalia contingentia subsint legi aeternae
title.zh: 自然界的偶然事物是否屬於永恆的法律之下

title.la: Utrum omnes res humanae subiiciantur legi aeternae
title.zh: 一切人間事情是否皆屬於永恆的法律之下

title.la: De lege naturali
title.zh: 論自然法律

title.la: Utrum lex naturalis sit habitus
title.zh: 自然法律是否為習性

title.la: Utrum lex naturalis contineat plura praecepta, sed unum tantum
title.zh: 自然法律含有許多指令或僅一條指令

title.la: Utrum omnes actus virtutum sint de lege naturae
title.zh: 德性之行動是否皆屬於自然法律

title.la: Utrum lex naturae sit una apud omnes
title.zh: 人是否共有同一自然法律

title.la: Utrum lex naturae mutari possit
title.zh: 自然法律是否能夠改變

title.la: Utrum lex naturae possit a corde hominis aboleri
title.zh: 自然法律是否能從人心中消滅

title.la: De lege humana
title.zh: 論人爲法律

title.la: Utrum fuerit utile aliquas leges poni ab hominibus
title.zh: 訂立人為法律是否有用

title.la: Utrum omnis lex humanitus posita a lege naturali derivetur
title.zh: 人為法律是否皆源於自然法律

title.la: Utrum Isidorus inconvenienter qualitatem legis positivae describat
title.zh: 依希道對成文法律性質之描述是否合適

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter Isidorus divisionem legum humanarum ponat
title.zh: 依希道的人為法律分類是否適當

title.la: De potestate legis humanae
title.zh: 論人爲法律之權力

title.la: Utrum lex humana debeat poni in communi, sed magis in particulari
title.zh: 人為法律是否該是廣泛性的，而不該是個別性的

title.la: Utrum ad legem humanam pertineat omnia vitia cohibere
title.zh: 人為法律是否該禁絕一切惡習

title.la: Utrum lex humana praecipiat actus omnium virtutum
title.zh: 人為法律是否責成一切德性

title.la: Utrum lex humana imponat homini necessitatem in foro conscientiae
title.zh: 人為法律是否約束人的良心

title.la: Utrum omnes legi subiiciantur
title.zh: 是否凡人皆屬於法律權下

title.la: Utrum liceat ei qui subditur legi, praeter verba legis agere
title.zh: 屬於法律權下者，是否可以不守法律的字面意義

title.la: De mutatione legum
title.zh: 論法律之改變

title.la: Utrum lex humana debeat mutari
title.zh: 人為的法律是否該有某種改變

title.la: Utrum semper lex humana, quando aliquid melius occurrit, sit mutanda
title.zh: 若發現有更好的，入為法律是否常該改善

title.la: Utrum consuetudo possit obtinere vim legis aut legem amovere
title.zh: 習慣是否能取得法律的效力

title.la: Utrum rectores multitudinis possint in legibus humanis dispensare
title.zh: 管理羣眾之長官是否能豁免人為的法律

title.la: De lege veteri
title.zh: 論舊約之法律

title.la: Utrum lex vetus fuerit bona
title.zh: 舊約之法律是否優良

title.la: Utrum lex vetus fuerit a Deo
title.zh: 舊約的法律是否來自天主

title.la: Utrum lex vetus fuerit data per angelos, sed immediate a Deo
title.zh: 舊約的法律是否為通過天使而來的

title.la: Utrum lex vetus debuerit dari soli populo Iudaeorum
title.zh: 舊約的法律是否該只給猶太民族

title.la: Utrum omnes homines obligarentur ad observandam veterem legem
title.zh: 人是否皆應奉守舊約的法律

title.la: Utrum lex vetus convenienter fuerit data tempore moysi
title.zh: 在梅瑟時代頒訂舊約的法律是否合適

title.la: De praeceptis veteris legis
title.zh: 論舊約法律之訓令

title.la: Utrum in lege veteri contineatur nisi unum praeceptum
title.zh: 舊約的法律是否只有一個訓令

title.la: Utrum lex vetus contineat praecepta moralia
title.zh: 舊約的法律是否含有道德性的訓令

title.la: Utrum lex vetus contineat praecepta caeremonialia, praeter moralia
title.zh: 道德性訓令之外，舊約的法律是否含有禮儀性的訓令

title.la: Utrum praeter praecepta moralia et caeremonialia, sint aliqua praecepta iudicialia in veteri lege
title.zh: 道德性和禮儀性訓令之外，舊約的法律是否合有司法性的訓令

title.la: Utrum aliqua alia praecepta contineantur in lege veteri praeter moralia, iudicialia et caeremonialia
title.zh: 道德、司法、禮儀訓令之外，舊約的法律是否還含有別的訓令

title.la: Utrum lex vetus debuerit inducere ad observantiam praeceptorum per temporales promissiones et comminationes
title.zh: 舊約是否該用現世的賞罰許諾，促人遵守古11令

title.la: De praeceptis moralibus veteris legis
title.zh: 論舊約法律之道德訓令

title.la: Utrum omnia praecepta moralia pertineant ad legem naturae
title.zh: 舊約法律之道德哥11令是否皆屬於自然法律

title.la: Utrum praecepta moralia legis sint de omnibus actibus virtutum
title.zh: 舊約法律之道德訓令是否為關於一切德性的

title.la: Utrum omnia praecepta moralia veteris legis reducantur ad decem praecepta decalogi
title.zh: 舊約法律之一切道德育11令是否皆歸宗於十誡

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter praecepta decalogi distinguantur
title.zh: 十誠之訓令的區分是否適當

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter praecepta decalogi enumerentur
title.zh: 十誠之訓令的數目是否適當

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter ordinentur decem praecepta decalogi
title.zh: 十誠之十條訓令的次序是否合適

title.la: Utrum praecepta decalogi inconvenienter tradantur
title.zh: 十誠之首n令編寫的是否得體

title.la: Utrum praecepta decalogi sint dispensabilia
title.zh: 十誠之首11令是否可以豁免

title.la: Utrum modus virtutis cadat sub praecepto legis
title.zh: 秉持德性之心態或精神，是否屬於法律之訓令範閻

title.la: Utrum modus caritatis cadat sub praecepto divinae legis
title.zh: 秉持愛德之心態、或精神，是否屬於天主之法律的訓令範閻

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter distinguantur alia moralia praecepta legis praeter decalogum
title.zh: 十誠之外，是否尚宜區分法律之其他道德、訓令

title.la: Utrum praecepta moralia veteris legis iustificarent
title.zh: 舊約法律的道德訓令是否使人成義

title.la: De praeceptis caeremonialibus secundum se
title.zh: 論禮儀訓令

title.la: Utrum ratio praeceptorum caeremonialium in hoc consistat quod pertinent ad cultum Dei
title.zh: 禮儀訓令之理是否在於與敬禮天主有關

title.la: Utrum praecepta caeremonialia sint figuralia
title.zh: 禮儀訓令是否為象徵性的

title.la: Utrum debuerint esse multa caeremonialia praecepta
title.zh: 是否該有許多禮儀訊l令

title.la: Utrum caeremoniae veteris legis inconvenienter dividantur in sacrificia, sacra, sacramenta et observantias
title.zh: 舊約法律的禮儀是否宜分為祭品巴、聖物、聖事和守則四部分

title.la: De causis caeremonialium praeceptorum
title.zh: 論禮儀訓令之原因

title.la: Utrum caeremonialia praecepta habeant causam
title.zh: 禮儀訓令是否有原因

title.la: Utrum praecepta caeremonialia habeant causam litteralem, sed figuralem tantum
title.zh: 禮儀訓令是否兼有字面上的原因，抑或只有象徵的原因

title.la: Utrum possit conveniens ratio assignari caeremoniarum quae ad sacrificia pertinent
title.zh: 祭紀的禮儀是否有適當的理由

title.la: Utrum caeremoniarum veteris legis quae ad sacra pertinent sufficiens ratio assignari possit
title.zh: 關於聖物的禮儀是否有適當理由

title.la: Utrum sacramentorum veteris legis conveniens causa esse possit
title.zh: 舊約法律的聖事是否有合理的原因

title.la: Utrum observantiarum caeremonialium aliqua fuerit rationabilis causa
title.zh: 禮儀守則是否有正當原因

title.la: De duratione caeremonialium praeceptorum
title.zh: 論禮儀訓令之期限

title.la: Utrum caeremoniae legis fuerint ante legem
title.zh: 在頒布法律以前是否已有禮儀訓令

title.la: Utrum caeremoniae veteris legis habuerint virtutem iustificandi tempore legis
title.zh: 舊約法律的禮儀在法律有效期間，是否有成義的作用

title.la: Utrum caeremoniae veteris legis cessaverint in Christi adventu
title.zh: 是否基督來了後，舊約法律的禮儀便行廢止

title.la: Utrum post passionem Christi legalia possint sine peccato mortali observari
title.zh: 在基督受難後，是否可遵守法訂禮儀而沒有死罪

title.la: De praeceptis iudicialibus
title.zh: 論司法訓令

title.la: Utrum ratio praeceptorum iudicialium consistat in hoc quod sunt ordinantia ad proximum
title.zh: 司法訓令之理是否在於是關係他人的

title.la: Utrum praecepta iudicialia figurent aliquid
title.zh: 司法訓令是否有象徵意義

title.la: Utrum praecepta iudicialia veteris legis perpetuam obligationem habeant
title.zh: 舊約法律的司法訓令是否具有永恆的約束力

title.la: Utrum praecepta iudicialia possint habere aliquam certam divisionem
title.zh: 司法訓令是否能有明確的區分

title.la: De ratione iudicialium praeceptorum
title.zh: 論司法訓令之理由

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter lex vetus de principibus ordinaverit
title.zh: 舊約法律關於長官之規定是否合理

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter fuerint tradita praecepta iudicialia quantum ad popularium convictum
title.zh: 關於人民彼此之關係的司法訓令是否合理

title.la: Utrum iudicialia praecepta sint convenienter tradita quantum ad extraneos
title.zh: 關於外方人的司法訓令是否合理

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter lex vetus praecepta ediderit circa personas domesticas
title.zh: 舊約法律關於家屬的訓令是否合理

title.la: De lege Evangelii, quod dicitur lex nova
title.zh: 論稱爲新法律的福音法律本身

title.la: Utrum lex nova sit lex scripta
title.zh: 新法律是否為成文法律

title.la: Utrum lex nova iustificet
title.zh: 新法律是否有成義作用

title.la: Utrum lex nova debuerit dari a principio mundi
title.zh: 新法律是否該在世界創始時頒賜

title.la: Utrum lex nova sit duratura usque ad finem mundi
title.zh: 新法律是否要保存到世界末日

title.la: De comparatione legis novae ad legem veterem
title.zh: 論新法律之關係

title.la: Utrum lex nova sit alia a lege veteri
title.zh: 新法律是否與舊法律有別

title.la: Utrum lex nova legem veterem impleat
title.zh: 新法律是否成全舊法律

title.la: Utrum lex nova in lege veteri contineatur
title.zh: 新法律是否包括在舊法律內

title.la: Utrum lex nova sit gravior quam lex vetus
title.zh: 新法律是否比舊法律沉重

title.la: De his quae continentur in lege nova
title.zh: 論新法律之內容

title.la: Utrum lex nova aliquos exteriores actus debeat praecipere vel prohibere
title.zh: 新法律是否該命令或禁止外表行動

title.la: Utrum lex nova insufficienter exteriores actus ordinaverit
title.zh: 新法律關於外表行動之規定是否完備

title.la: Utrum circa interiores actus lex nova insufficienter hominem ordinaverit
title.zh: 釋疑2.便要講到。第三節新法律關於人內心活動的規定是否完備

title.la: Utrum convenienter in lege nova consilia quaedam determinata sint proposita
title.zh: 在新法律中，是否該提出某些固定的勸論

title.la: De necessitate gratiae
title.zh: 論恩寵之必要

title.la: Utrum homo sine gratia aliquod verum cognoscere possit
title.zh: 沒有恩寵，人是否能認識真理

title.la: Utrum homo possit velle et facere bonum absque gratia
title.zh: 沒有恩寵，人是否能願善及行善

title.la: Utrum homo possit diligere Deum super omnia ex solis naturalibus sine gratia
title.zh: 人沒有恩寵，單憑自然能力是否能愛天主在萬有之上

title.la: Utrum homo sine gratia per sua naturalia possit praecepta legis implere
title.zh: 人沒有恩寵，單憑自然能力是否能滿全法律之訓令

title.la: Utrum homo possit mereri vitam aeternam sine gratia
title.zh: 沒有恩寵，人是否能立功掙得永生

title.la: Utrum homo possit seipsum ad gratiam praeparare per seipsum, absque exteriori auxilio gratiae
title.zh: 沒有恩寵外來的幫助，人是否能自力準備自己獲取恩寵

title.la: Utrum homo possit resurgere a peccato sine auxilio gratiae
title.zh: 人沒有恩寵幫助，是否能改過自新

title.la: Utrum homo sine gratia possit non peccare
title.zh: 沒有恩寵，人是否能不犯罪

title.la: Utrum ille qui iam consecutus est gratiam, per seipsum possit operari bonum et vitare peccatum, absque alio auxilio gratiae
title.zh: 若非另有恩寵幫助，已有恩寵的人，是否能憑自己行善避惡

title.la: Utrum homo in gratia constitutus indigeat auxilio gratiae ad perseverandum
title.zh: 已有恩寵的人，是否仍需恩寵的幫助以保持恆心

title.la: De gratia Dei quantum ad eius essentiam
title.zh: 論天主之恩寵本質

title.la: Utrum gratia ponat aliquid in anima
title.zh: 恩寵是否在靈魂上產生什麼東西

title.la: Utrum gratia sit qualitas animae
title.zh: 恩寵是否為靈魂的品質

title.la: Utrum gratia sit idem quod virtus
title.zh: 恩寵是否與德J性相同

title.la: Utrum gratia sit in essentia animae sicut in subiecto, sed in aliqua potentiarum
title.zh: 恩寵是以靈魂之本體，抑或以其某機能為主體

title.la: De divisione gratiae
title.zh: 論恩寵之分類

title.la: Utrum gratia convenienter dividatur per gratiam gratum facientem et gratiam gratis datam
title.zh: 恩寵是否可分為白白施予的恩寵，及使中快天主的恩寵

title.la: Utrum gratia convenienter dividatur per operantem et cooperantem
title.zh: 恩寵是否可分為主導作用恩寵，與配合作用恩寵

title.la: Utrum gratia convenienter dividatur in praevenientem et subsequentem
title.zh: 恩寵是否可以分為先施的與後施的

title.la: Utrum gratia gratis data inconvenienter ab apostolo distinguatur
title.zh: 宗徒對白白施予的恩寵所做的區分，是否合理

title.la: Utrum gratia gratis data sit dignior quam gratia gratum faciens
title.zh: 白白施予的恩寵是否比使中悅天主的恩寵高貴

title.la: De causa gratiae
title.zh: 論恩寵之原因

title.la: Utrum solus Deus sit causa gratiae
title.zh: 是否只有天主是恩寵之原因

title.la: Utrum requiratur aliqua praeparatio sive dispositio ad gratiam ex parte hominis
title.zh: 人是否須有針對恩寵的準備或配合

title.la: Utrum ex necessitate detur gratia se praeparanti ad gratiam, vel facienti quod in se est
title.zh: 對恩寵有準備的、或盡力而為的，是否必然獲得恩寵

title.la: Utrum gratia sit maior in uno quam in alio
title.zh: 一人的恩寵是否大於另一人的恩寵有闇第四節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum homo possit scire se habere gratiam
title.zh: 人是否能知道自己有恩寵

title.la: De effectibus gratiae
title.zh: 論恩寵之效果：首論罪人之成義

title.la: Utrum iustificatio impii sit remissio peccatorum
title.zh: 罪人之成義是否為罪過之赦免有關第一前，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum ad remissionem culpae, quae est iustificatio impii, requiratur gratiae infusio
title.zh: 罪過之赦免或罪人之成義，是否需要恩寵之灌輸

title.la: Utrum ad iustificationem impii requiratur motus liberi arbitrii
title.zh: 罪人之成義是否需要自由意志之行動

title.la: Utrum ad iustificationem impii requiratur motus fidei
title.zh: 罪人之成義是否需要信德之行動

title.la: Utrum ad iustificationem impii requiratur motus liberi arbitrii in peccatum
title.zh: 罪人之成義是否需要針對罪惡的自由意志之行動

title.la: Utrum remissio peccatorum debeat numerari inter ea quae requiruntur ad iustificationem impii
title.zh: 罪過之赦免是否應算為罪人成義所必要者之一

title.la: Utrum iustificatio impii fiat in instanti, sed successive
title.zh: 罪人之成義是突發的，抑或漸進的

title.la: Utrum gratiae infusio sit prima ordine naturae inter ea quae requiruntur ad iustificationem impii
title.zh: 罪人之成義的要件中，恩寵之灌輸是否按自然次序最先

title.la: Utrum iustificatio impii sit maximum opus Dei
title.zh: 罪人之成義是否為天主之最大成就

title.la: Utrum iustificatio impii sit opus miraculosum
title.zh: 罪人之成義是否為奇蹟

title.la: De merito
title.zh: 論功績

title.la: Utrum homo possit aliquid mereri a Deo
title.zh: 人是否能由天主掙得什麼

title.la: Utrum aliquis sine gratia possit mereri vitam aeternam
title.zh: 人沒有恩寵是否能掙得永生

title.la: Utrum homo in gratia constitutus possit mereri vitam aeternam ex condigno
title.zh: 有恩寵的人是否能相當地掙得永生

title.la: Utrum gratia sit principium meriti principalius per caritatem quam per alias virtutes
title.zh: 恩寵之為功績之根本，是否主要靠愛德勝過靠其他德性

title.la: Utrum homo possit sibi mereri primam gratiam
title.zh: 人是否能為自己掙得第一個恩寵

title.la: Utrum homo possit alteri mereri primam gratiam
title.zh: 人是否能替他人掙得第一個恩寵

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit mereri sibi ipsi reparationem post lapsum
title.zh: 人是否能為自己掙得墮落後之補救

title.la: Utrum homo possit mereri augmentum gratiae vel caritatis
title.zh: 人是否能掙得恩寵或愛德之增加

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit perseverantiam mereri
title.zh: 人是否能掙得至終不渝

title.la: Utrum temporalia bona cadant sub merito
title.zh: 現世之善是否屬於功績範圍

title.la: Secunda secundae
title.zh: 第二部之二

title.la: De fide
title.zh: 論信德的對象

title.la: Utrum obiectum fidei sit veritas prima
title.zh: 信德的對象是否為第一真理

title.la: Utrum obiectum fidei sit aliquid complexum per modum enuntiabilis
title.zh: 信德的對象是否是一按命題方式陳述的合成事物

title.la: Utrum fidei possit subesse falsum
title.zh: 假的事物可否成為信德的對象

title.la: Utrum obiectum fidei sit aliquid visum
title.zh: 信德的對象是否可以是一些看見的事物

title.la: Utrum ea quae sunt fidei possint esse scita
title.zh: 信德的事物是否可以成為知識的對象

title.la: Utrum credibilia sint per certos articulos distinguenda
title.zh: 應信的事物是否應分為某些條文

title.la: Utrum articuli fidei creverint secundum temporum successionem
title.zh: 信{惡的條文是否隨時增加

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter articuli fidei enumerentur
title.zh: 信德條文的數目是否適當

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter articuli fidei in symbolo ponantur
title.zh: 將信德、條文編在4篇信經裡是否適宜

title.la: Utrum pertineat ad summum pontificem fidei symbolum ordinare
title.zh: 教宗是否有權編製信經

title.la: De actu fidei
title.zh: 論信德的內心行爲

title.la: Utrum credere sit cum assensione cogitare
title.zh: 相信是否就是贊同地思想

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter distinguatur actus fidei per hoc quod est credere Deo, credere Deum et credere in Deum
title.zh: 將信德行為分為信賴天主、信天主和信仰天主是否適當

title.la: Utrum credere sit necessarium ad salutem
title.zh: 為得救是否必須相信一些超出自然理性之上的事物

title.la: Utrum ea quae ratione naturali probari possunt sit necessarium credere
title.zh: 是否必須相信那些可用自然理性證明的事物

title.la: Utrum teneatur homo ad credendum aliquid explicite
title.zh: 人是否必須明顯地相信一些事物

title.la: Utrum aequaliter omnes teneantur ad habendum fidem explicitam
title.zh: 是否人人都同樣必須明顯地相信

title.la: Utrum credere explicite mysterium Christi sit de necessitate salutis apud omnes
title.zh: 為得救是否人人都必須明顯地相信基督的奧蹟

title.la: Utrum credere Trinitatem explicite fuerit de necessitate salutis
title.zh: 為得救是否必須明顯地相信天主三位一體

title.la: Utrum credere sit meritorium
title.zh: 相信是否有功勞

title.la: Utrum ratio inducta ad ea quae sunt fidei diminuat meritum fidei
title.zh: 支持我們信德的理性理由，是否減少信德的功勞

title.la: De exteriori fidei actu
title.zh: 論信德的外表行爲

title.la: Utrum confessio sit actus fidei
title.zh: 明認信德是不是一個信德的行為

title.la: Utrum confessio fidei sit necessaria ad salutem
title.zh: 為得救是否必須明認信德

title.la: De ipsa fidei virtute
title.zh: 論信德的德性

title.la: Utrum haec sit competen fidei definitio: fides est substantia sperandarum rerum, argumentum non apparentium
title.zh: 「信德是所希望之事的實體，是未見之事的確證」'信德的這個定義是否恰當

title.la: Utrum fides sit in intellectu sicut in subiecto
title.zh: 信德是否歸屬於理智

title.la: Utrum caritas sit forma fidei
title.zh: 愛德是不是信德的形式

title.la: Utrum fides informis fiat formata, aut e converso
title.zh: 是否不成形的信德可以變為成形的，或成形的信德可以變為不成形的

title.la: Utrum fides sit virtus
title.zh: 信德是不是一種德性

title.la: Utrum sit una fides
title.zh: 信德是不是單一不分的

title.la: Utrum fides sit prima inter virtutes
title.zh: 信德是不是諸德、之首

title.la: Utrum fides sit certior scientia et aliis virtutibus intellectualibus
title.zh: 信德、是否比知識以及其他理智之德更為確實

title.la: De habentibus fidem
title.zh: 論有信德者

title.la: Utrum angelus aut homo in sua prima conditione fidem habuerit
title.zh: 天使或人在其原始狀態下是否曾有信德

title.la: Utrum in daemonibus sit fides
title.zh: 魔鬼是否有信德

title.la: Utrum haereticus qui discredit unum articulum fidei possit habere fidem informem de aliis articulis
title.zh: 一個不相信一條信理的異端派人士，對於其他的信理是否還能有不成形的信德

title.la: Utrum fides possit esse maior in uno quam in alio
title.zh: 一個人的信德是否可以大於另一個人的信德

title.la: De causa fidei
title.zh: 論信德的原因

title.la: Utrum fides sit homini infusa a Deo
title.zh: 信德是否由天主灌輸給人

title.la: Utrum fides informis sit donum Dei
title.zh: 不成形的信德是否也是天主的一種恩賜

title.la: De effectibus fidei
title.zh: 論信德的效果

title.la: Utrum timor sit effectus fidei
title.zh: 畏懼是不是信德的一種效果

title.la: Utrum purificatio cordis sit effectus fidei
title.zh: 淨化心靈是不是信德的一種效果

title.la: De dono intellectus
title.zh: 論聰敏之恩賜

title.la: Utrum intellectus sit donum Spiritus Sancti
title.zh: 聰敏是不是聖神的才重恩賜

title.la: Utrum donum intellectus simul habeatur cum fide
title.zh: 聰敏之恩賜是否能與信德、同時並存

title.la: Utrum intellectus qui ponitur donum Spiritus Sancti sit practicus, sed speculativus tantum
title.zh: 聰敏之恩賜只是鑑賞性的，抑或也是實踐性的

title.la: Utrum donum intellectus insit omnibus hominibus habentibus gratiam
title.zh: 是否所有在恩寵狀態之下的人，都有聰敏之恩賜

title.la: Utrum intellectus donum inveniatur etiam in habentibus gratiam gratum facientem
title.zh: 沒有聖化恩寵的人是否也有聰敏之恩賜

title.la: Utrum donum intellectus distinguatur ab aliis donis
title.zh: 聰敏之恩賜是否與其他恩賜不同

title.la: Utrum dono intellectus respondeat beatitudo sexta, scilicet, beati mundo corde, quoniam ipsi Deum videbunt
title.zh: 「心裡潔淨的人是有福的，因為他們要看見天主。」此真褔第六端是否與總敏之恩賜相配

title.la: Utrum in fructibus fides respondeat dono intellectus
title.zh: 聖神果實中之信德是否與聰敏之恩賜相配

title.la: De dono scientiae
title.zh: 論明達之恩賜

title.la: Utrum scientia sit donum
title.zh: 明遠是不是一種恩賜

title.la: Utrum scientiae donum sit circa res divinas
title.zh: 明達之恩賜是否關於天主之事物

title.la: Utrum scientia quae ponitur donum sit scientia practica
title.zh: 明遠之恩賜是否是實踐的知識

title.la: Utrum scientiae respondeat tertia beatitudo, scilicet: beati qui lugent, quoniam ipsi consolabuntur
title.zh: 「哀慟的人是有福的，因為他們要受安慰。」此真褔第二端是否與明遠之恩賜相配

title.la: De infidelitate
title.zh: 總論不信

title.la: Utrum infidelitas sit peccatum
title.zh: 不信是不是罪

title.la: Utrum infidelitas sit in intellectu sicut in subiecto
title.zh: 不信是否以理智為其主體

title.la: Utrum infidelitas sit maximum peccatorum
title.zh: 不信是不是最大的罪

title.la: Utrum quaelibet actio infidelis sit peccatum
title.zh: 是否不信者每一個行為都是罪

title.la: Utrum sint plures infidelitatis species
title.zh: 是否有多種不同的不信

title.la: Utrum infidelitas gentilium sive paganorum sit gravior ceteris
title.zh: 外邦人或外教人的不信，是否重於其他各種的不信

title.la: Utrum sit cum infidelibus publice disputandum
title.zh: 是否應該與不信者公開辯論

title.la: Utrum infideles compellendi sint ad fidem
title.zh: 是否應該強使不信者接受信德、

title.la: Utrum cum infidelibus possit communicari
title.zh: 是否可與不信者來往

title.la: Utrum infideles possint habere praelationem vel dominium supra fideles
title.zh: 不信者對信徒是否有統治或管轄權

title.la: Utrum ritus infidelium sint tolerandi
title.zh: 不信者的宗教儀式是否應予容許

title.la: Utrum pueri iudaeorum et aliorum infidelium sint baptizandi parentibus invitis
title.zh: 猶太教徒以及其他不信者的幼小子女，是否應該相反他們父母的意思而給他們付洗

title.la: De haeresi
title.zh: 論異端

title.la: Utrum haeresis sit infidelitatis species
title.zh: 異端是不是一種不信

title.la: Utrum haeresis sit proprie circa ea quae sunt fidei
title.zh: 異端是否真與信德的事物有關

title.la: Utrum haeretici sint tolerandi
title.zh: 是否應該容忍異端教徒

title.la: Utrum revertentes ab haeresi sint omnino ab ecclesia recipiendi
title.zh: 教會是否應該接納回頭改過的異端教徒

title.la: De apostasia
title.zh: 論背棄信德

title.la: Utrum apostasia pertineat ad infidelitatem
title.zh: 背棄信德是否屬於不信

title.la: Utrum princeps propter apostasiam a fide amittat dominium in subditos, quin ei obedire non teneantur
title.zh: 君王是否因背棄信德、而喪失對屬下的統治權，致使屬下不再有義務服從他

title.la: De blasphemia in generali
title.zh: 總論褻瀆之罪

title.la: Utrum blasphemia opponatur confessioni fidei
title.zh: 褻潰是否相反明認信德

title.la: Utrum blasphemia semper sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 褻清是否常是死罪

title.la: Utrum peccatum blasphemiae sit maximum peccatum
title.zh: 褻潰之罪是不是最大的罪

title.la: Utrum damnati blasphement
title.zh: 受永罰者是否犯褻潰之罪

title.la: De blasphemia in Spiritum Sanctum
title.zh: 論褻瀆聖神

title.la: Utrum peccatum in spiritum sanctum sit idem quod peccatum ex certa malitia
title.zh: 反對聖神的罪是否與源自某種惡意的罪相同

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter assignentur sex species peccati in Spiritum Sanctum
title.zh: 將反對聖神的罪分為六種是否適當

title.la: Utrum peccatum in Spiritum Sanctum sit irremissibile
title.zh: 反對聖神的罪是否能被赦免

title.la: Utrum homo possit primo peccare in spiritum sanctum non praesuppositis aliis peccatis
title.zh: 人是否能不犯其他的罪，而首先犯反對聖神的罪

title.la: De vitiis oppositis scientiae et intellectui
title.zh: 論心智的盲瞽與感覺的遲鈍

title.la: Utrum caecitas mentis sit peccatum
title.zh: 心智盲督是不是罪

title.la: Utrum hebetudo sensus sit aliud a caecitate mentis
title.zh: 感覺遲鈍是不是與心智盲暫不同

title.la: Utrum caecitas mentis et hebetudo sensus oriantur ex vitiis carnalibus
title.zh: 心智的盲督與感覺的遲鈍是否來自肉慾的罪

title.la: De praeceptis pertinentibus ad fidem, scientiam, et intellectum
title.zh: 論有關信德、明達和聰敏的誡命

title.la: Utrum in veteri lege dari debuerint praecepta credendi
title.zh: 在舊約法律裡'是否應該含有關於信德的誠命

title.la: Utrum in veteri lege convenienter tradantur praecepta pertinentia ad scientiam et intellectum
title.zh: 在舊約法律裡'是否適當地制訂了有關明達和聰敏的誠命

title.la: De ipsa spe
title.zh: 論望德

title.la: Utrum spes sit virtus
title.zh: 希望是不是一種德性

title.la: Utrum obiectum proprium spei sit beatitudo aeterna
title.zh: 永福是不是望德固有的對象

title.la: Utrum unus homo possit sperare beatitudinem alterius
title.zh: 一個人是否能夠希望別人得到永福

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit licite sperare in homine
title.zh: 人是否可合法地寄望於人

title.la: Utrum spes sit virtus theologica
title.zh: 望德是不是向天主之德

title.la: Utrum spes sit virtus distincta ab aliis virtutibus theologicis
title.zh: 望德是不是異於其他向天主之德的德性

title.la: Utrum spes praecedat fidem
title.zh: 望德是否先於信德

title.la: Utrum caritas sit prior spe
title.zh: 愛德是否先於望德

title.la: De subiecto spei
title.zh: 論望德的主體

title.la: Utrum spes sit in voluntate sicut in subiecto
title.zh: 望德是否以意志為主體

title.la: Utrum spes sit in beatis
title.zh: 享永褔者是否有望德

title.la: Utrum spes sit in damnatis
title.zh: 受永罰者是否有望德

title.la: Utrum spes viatorum habeat certitudinem
title.zh: 世途旅人的望德、是否有確定性

title.la: De dono timoris
title.zh: 論敬畏之恩賜

title.la: Utrum Deus timeri possit
title.zh: 天主是否能受人畏懼

title.la: Utrum timor convenienter dividatur in filialem, initialem, servilem et mundanum
title.zh: 將畏懼分為孝愛的、初步的、奴隸的、世俗的，是否適當

title.la: Utrum timor mundanus sit semper malus
title.zh: 世俗的畏懼是否常是不好的

title.la: Utrum timor servilis sit bonus
title.zh: 奴隸的畏懼是否是善的

title.la: Utrum timor servilis sit idem in substantia cum timore filiali
title.zh: 奴隸的畏懼與孝愛的畏懼，本質上是否相同

title.la: Utrum timor servilis remaneat cum caritate
title.zh: 奴隸的畏懼是否能與愛德相容並存

title.la: Utrum timor sit initium sapientiae
title.zh: 畏懼是不是智慧的開始

title.la: Utrum timor initialis differat secundam substantiam a timore filiali
title.zh: 初步的畏懼與孝愛的畏懼，本質上是否不同

title.la: Utrum timor sit donum Spiritus Sancti
title.zh: 畏懼是不是聖神的恩賜

title.la: Utrum crescente aritate diminuatur timor
title.zh: 是否愛德長則畏懼消

title.la: Utrum timor remaneat in patria
title.zh: 在天鄉是否還有畏懼

title.la: Utrum paupertas spiritus sit beaitudo respondens dono timoris
title.zh: 神貧是不是與敬畏的恩賜相配的真褔

title.la: De desperatione
title.zh: 論失望

title.la: Utrum desperatio sit peccatum
title.zh: 失望是不是罪

title.la: Utrum desperatio sine infidelitate esse possit
title.zh: 是否能沒有不信而有失望

title.la: Utrum desperatio sit maximum peccatorum
title.zh: 失望是不是最大的罪

title.la: Utrum desperatio ex acedia oriatur
title.zh: 失望是否來自沮喪

title.la: De praesumptione
title.zh: 論妄望

title.la: Utrum praesumptio innitatur Deo, an propriae virtuti
title.zh: 妄望所依恃的是天主，抑或是自己的能力

title.la: Utrum praesumptio sit peccatum
title.zh: 妄望是不是罪

title.la: Utrum praesumptio magis opponatur timori quam spei
title.zh: 妄望是否相反敬畏甚於相反望德

title.la: Utrum praesumptio causetur ex inani gloria
title.zh: 妄望是否來自虛榮

title.la: De praeceptis pertinentibus ad spem et timorem
title.zh: 論關於望德和敬畏的誡命

title.la: Utrum aliquod praeceptum sit dandum pertinens ad virtutem spei
title.zh: 是否應有關於望德的誠命

title.la: Utrum de timore fuerit dandum aliquod praeceptum in lege
title.zh: 是否應有關於敬畏或畏懼的誡命

title.la: De ipsa caritate
title.zh: 論愛德

title.la: Utrum caritas sit amicitia
title.zh: 愛德是否是友誼

title.la: Utrum caritas sit aliquid creatum in anima
title.zh: 愛德是不是在靈魂裡的一種受造物

title.la: Utrum caritas sit virtus
title.zh: 愛德是否是德性

title.la: Utrum caritas sit virtus specialis
title.zh: 愛德、是不是一種特殊的德性

title.la: Utrum caritas sit una virtus
title.zh: 愛德是否只有一種

title.la: Utrum caritas sit excellentissima virtutum
title.zh: 愛德是否是最崇高的德J性

title.la: Utrum sine caritate possit esse aliqua vera virtus
title.zh: 沒有愛德，是否能有真正的德性

title.la: Utrum caritas sit forma virtutum
title.zh: 愛德是否是各種德、性的形式

title.la: De subiecto caritatis
title.zh: 論愛德的主體

title.la: Utrum voluntas sit subiectum caritatis
title.zh: 意志是否是愛德的主體

title.la: Utrum caritas causetur in nobis ex infusione
title.zh: 愛德是否是藉灌輸在我們內形成的

title.la: Utrum caritas infundatur secundum quantitatem naturalium
title.zh: 愛德是否按照自然天賦的能力而灌輸的

title.la: Utrum caritas augeri possit
title.zh: 愛德是否能增長

title.la: Utrum caritas augeatur per additionem
title.zh: 愛德是否因加添而增長

title.la: Utrum quolibet actu caritatis caritas augeatur
title.zh: 愛德是否因每一個愛德行為而增長

title.la: Utrum caritas augeatur in infinitum
title.zh: 愛德是否無限制地增長

title.la: Utrum caritas in hac vita possit esse perfecta
title.zh: 愛德在此生是否能是完善的

title.la: Utrum convenienter distinguantur tres gradus caritatis: incipiens, proficiens, et perfecta
title.zh: 將愛德、分為初級的、進步的和完善的三級，是否適當

title.la: Utrum caritas possit diminui
title.zh: 愛德、是否能消滅

title.la: Utrum caritas semel habita possit amitti
title.zh: 既有的愛德是否能再喪失

title.la: Utrum caritas amittatur per unum actum peccati mortalis
title.zh: 愛德是否因一個死罪的行為而失去

title.la: De obiecto caritatis
title.zh: 論愛德的對象

title.la: Utrum dilectio caritatis sistat in Deo, an se extendat etiam ad proximum
title.zh: 愛德之愛是否止於天主，或者也應該推廣到近人

title.la: Utrum caritas sit ex caritate diligenda
title.zh: 是否應該用愛德去愛愛德

title.la: Utrum etiam creaturae irrationales sint ex caritate diligendae
title.zh: 是否也應該用愛德去愛無靈受造物

title.la: Utrum homo debeat seipsum ex caritate diligere
title.zh: 人是否應該用愛德去愛他自己

title.la: Utrum homo debeat corpus suum ex caritate diligere
title.zh: 人是否應該用愛德去愛他自己的身體

title.la: Utrum peccatores sint ex caritate diligendi
title.zh: 是否應該用愛德去愛罪人

title.la: Utrum peccatores diligant seipsos
title.zh: 罪人是否愛自己

title.la: Utrum sit de necessitate caritatis ut inimici diligantur
title.zh: 愛德是否要我們愛仇人

title.la: Utrum sit de necessitate caritatis quod aliquis signa et effectus dilectionis inimico exhibeat
title.zh: 愛德是否要人向仇人表示愛的徵象和事實

title.la: Utrum debeamus angelos ex caritate diligere
title.zh: 我們是否應該用愛德去愛天使

title.la: Utrum debeamus daemones ex caritate diligere
title.zh: 我們是否應該以愛德去愛魔鬼

title.la: Utrum convenienter enumerentur quatuor ex caritate diligenda: scilicet Deus, proximus, corpus nostrum, et nos ipsi?
title.zh: 將應以愛德、去愛的分列為囚，即天主、我們的近人、我們的身體和我們自己，是否適當

title.la: De ordine caritatis
title.zh: 論愛德的次序

title.la: Utrum in caritate sit ordo
title.zh: 愛德是否有一次序

title.la: Utrum Deus sit magis diligendus quam proximus
title.zh: 是否人應該愛天主勝於愛近人

title.la: Utrum homo debeat ex caritate plus Deum diligere quam seipsum
title.zh: 人是否應該以愛德愛天主，勝於愛自己

title.la: Utrum homo ex caritate magis debeat diligere seipsum quam proximum
title.zh: 人是否應該以愛德愛他自己，勝於愛近人

title.la: Utrum homo magis debeat diligere proximum quam corpus proprium
title.zh: 人是否應該愛近人勝於愛他自己的身體

title.la: Utrum unus proximus sit magis diligendus quam alius
title.zh: 是否應該愛一個近人勝於愛另一個近人

title.la: Utrum magis debeamus diligere meliores quam nobis coniunctiores
title.zh: 我們是否應該愛更善的人，勝於愛與我們更親近的人

title.la: Utrum sit maxime diligendus ille qui est nobis coniunctus secundum carnalem originem
title.zh: 是否應該最愛那與我們有血統關{系的人

title.la: Utrum homo ex caritate magis debeat diligere filium quam patrem
title.zh: 人是否應該以愛德愛子女，勝於愛父親

title.la: Utrum homo magis debeat diligere matrem quam patrem
title.zh: 人是否應該愛母親，勝於愛父親

title.la: Utrum homo plus debeat diligere uxorem quam patrem et matrem
title.zh: 人是否應該愛妻子，勝於愛父母有關第十一章，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum homo magis debeat diligere benefactorem quam beneficiatum
title.zh: 人是否應該愛那施恩於己的人，勝於愛那受恩於己的人

title.la: Utrum ordo caritatis remaneat in patria
title.zh: 在天鄉是否還保有愛德的次序

title.la: De principali actu caritatis, qui est dilectio
title.zh: 論愛德的主要行爲：愛

title.la: Utrum caritatis magis sit proprium amari quam amare
title.zh: 何者更屬於愛德，愛還是受愛

title.la: Utrum amare, secundum quod est actus caritatis, nihil sit aliud quam benevolentia
title.zh: 視作愛德之行為的愛，是否與善意相同

title.la: Utrum Deus propter seipsum, sed propter aliud, diligatur ex caritate
title.zh: 是否應該為了天主自己而以愛德愛祂

title.la: Utrum Deus in hac vita possit immediate amari
title.zh: 是否在今生能直接愛天主

title.la: Utrum Deus possit totaliter amari
title.zh: 是否可以完全地愛天主

title.la: Utrum divinae dilectionis sit aliquis modus habendus
title.zh: 對天主的愛是否應有某種模式

title.la: Utrum sit magis meritorium diligere inimicum quam amicum
title.zh: 是否愛仇人比愛友人功勞更大

title.la: Utrum sit magis meritorium diligere proximum quam diligere Deum
title.zh: 愛近人是否比愛天主功勞更大

title.la: De gaudio
title.zh: 論喜樂

title.la: Utrum gaudium sit effectus caritatis in nobis
title.zh: 喜樂是否是愛德、在我們身上所造成的效果

title.la: Utrum gaudium spirituale quod ex caritate causatur recipiat admixtionem tristitiae
title.zh: 來自愛德的神樂，是否能與憂苦混合而並存

title.la: Utrum spirituale gaudium quod ex caritate causatur possit in nobis impleri
title.zh: 來自愛德的神樂在我們內是否能是圓滿的

title.la: Utrum gaudium sit virtus
title.zh: 喜樂是否是德J性

title.la: De pace
title.zh: 論平安

title.la: Utrum pax sit idem quod concordia
title.zh: 平安是否與意見一致相同

title.la: Utrum omnia appetant pacem
title.zh: 是否一切的東西都欲求平安

title.la: Utrum pax sit proprius effectus caritatis
title.zh: 平安是否是愛德固有的效果

title.la: Utrum pax sit virtus
title.zh: 平安是否是一種德性

title.la: De misericordia
title.zh: 論憐憫

title.la: Utrum malum sit proprie motivum ad misericordiam
title.zh: 惡或災禍是不是憐憫的本然起因

title.la: Utrum defectus sit ratio miserendi ex parte miserentis
title.zh: 憐憫者的缺欠是不是d憐憫的原因

title.la: Utrum misericordia sit virtus
title.zh: 憐憫是否是德J性

title.la: Utrum misericordia sit maxima virtutum
title.zh: 憐憫是否是最大的德性

title.la: De beneficentia
title.zh: 論施惠

title.la: Utrum beneficentia sit actus caritatis
title.zh: 施惠是否是愛德的行為

title.la: Utrum sit omnibus benefaciendum
title.zh: 是否應該施惠給所有的人

title.la: Utrum sit magis benefaciendum his qui sunt nobis magis coniuncti
title.zh: 是否更應該施惠於那些與我們關係更密切的人

title.la: Utrum beneficentia sit specialis virtus
title.zh: 施惠是否是一種特殊的德性

title.la: De eleemosyna
title.zh: 論施捨

title.la: Utrum dare eleemosynam sit actus caritatis
title.zh: 施拾是否是愛德的行為

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter eleemosynarum genera distinguantur
title.zh: 施拾的種類是否分得適當

title.la: Utrum eleemosynae corporales sint potiores quam spirituales
title.zh: 是否形體的施拾比神性的施拾更好

title.la: Utrum eleemosynae corporales habeant effectum spiritualem
title.zh: 形體的施拾是否有神性的效果

title.la: Utrum dare eleemosynam sit in praecepto
title.zh: 施拾是否是一件命令的事

title.la: Utrum aliquis debeat eleemosynam dare de necessario
title.zh: 是否應該以自己所需行施拾

title.la: Utrum possit eleemosyna fieri de illicite acquisitis
title.zh: 是否可用不義之所得行施拾

title.la: Utrum ille qui est in potestate alterius constitutus possit eleemosynam facere
title.zh: 位於他人權下者是否可以施拾

title.la: Utrum sit magis propinquioribus eleemosyna facienda
title.zh: 是否更應該施捨給那些有更密切關係的人

title.la: Utrum eleemosyna sit abundanter facienda
title.zh: 是否應該大量施拾

title.la: De correctione fraterna
title.zh: 論兄弟規勸

title.la: Utrum fraterna correctio sit actus caritatis
title.zh: 兄弟規勸是否是愛德的行為

title.la: Utrum correctio fraterna sit in praecepto
title.zh: 兄弟規勸是否是屬於命令的事

title.la: Utrum correctio fraterna pertineat nisi ad praelatos
title.zh: 兄弟規勸是否只是神長的事

title.la: Utrum aliquis teneatur corrigere praelatum suum
title.zh: 人是否應該誇諒自己的神長

title.la: Utrum peccator corrigere debeat delinquentem
title.zh: 罪人是否應該規勸作惡的人

title.la: Utrum aliquis debeat a correctione cessare propter timorem ne ille fiat deterior
title.zh: 是否應該因為怕人變得更壞而放棄規勸

title.la: Utrum in correctione fraterna debeat, ex necessitate praecepti, admonitio secreta praecedere denuntiationem
title.zh: 兄弟規勸的命令是否命人在告發之前，先應私下規勸

title.la: Utrum testium inductio debeat praecedere publicam denuntiationem
title.zh: 是否應在公開告發之前先引進證人

title.la: De odio
title.zh: 論恨

title.la: Utrum Deum aliquis odio habere possit
title.zh: 是否有人能恨天主

title.la: Utrum odium Dei sit maximum peccatorum
title.zh: 恨天主是否是最大的罪

title.la: Utrum omne odium proximi sit peccatum
title.zh: 恨近人是否常有罪

title.la: Utrum odium proximi sit gravissimum peccatum eorum quae in proximo committuntur
title.zh: 恨近人是否是冒犯近人之罪中最重大的

title.la: Utrum odium sit vitium capitale
title.zh: 恨是否是一種罪宗

title.la: Utrum odium oriatur ex invidia
title.zh: 恨是否起於嫉妒

title.la: De acedia
title.zh: 論沮喪

title.la: Utrum acedia sit peccatum
title.zh: 沮喪是否是罪

title.la: Utrum acedia sit speciale vitium
title.zh: 沮喪是否是特殊的罪或惡習

title.la: Utrum acedia sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 沮喪是否是死罪

title.la: Utrum acedia debeat poni vitium capitale
title.zh: 是否應把沮喪列為罪宗

title.la: De invidia
title.zh: 論嫉妒

title.la: Utrum invidia sit tristitia
title.zh: 嫉妒是否是憂苦或哀愁

title.la: Utrum invidia sit peccatum
title.zh: 嫉妒是否是罪

title.la: Utrum invidia sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 嫉妒是否是死罪

title.la: Utrum invidia sit vitium capitale
title.zh: 嫉妒是否是罪宗

title.la: De discordia
title.zh: 論相反平安的不睦

title.la: Utrum discordia sit peccatum
title.zh: 不陸是否是罪

title.la: Utrum discordia sit filia inanis gloriae
title.zh: 不陸是否是虛榮的女兒

title.la: De contentione
title.zh: 論爭論

title.la: Utrum contentio sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 爭論是否是死罪

title.la: Utrum contentio sit filia inanis gloriae
title.zh: 爭論是否是虛榮的女兒

title.la: De schisma
title.zh: 論分裂

title.la: Utrum schisma sit peccatum speciale
title.zh: 分裂是否是一種特別的罪

title.la: Utrum schisma gravius peccatum sit quam infidelitas
title.zh: 分裂之罪是否重於不信

title.la: Utrum schismatici habeant aliquam potestatem
title.zh: 分裂者是否有一些權力

title.la: Utrum poena schismaticorum sit conveniens ut excommunicentur
title.zh: 絕罰是否是對裂教徒一種適當的處分

title.la: De bello
title.zh: 論戰爭

title.la: Utrum bellare semper sit peccatum
title.zh: 戰爭是否常是罪

title.la: Utrum clericis et episcopis liceat pugnare
title.zh: 神職人員及主教是否可以參與戰鬥

title.la: Utrum sit licitum in bellis uti insidiis
title.zh: 作戰時是否可以使用詭計

title.la: Utrum in diebus festis liceat bellare
title.zh: 是否可以在慶日或節日上作戰

title.la: De rixa
title.zh: 論爭鬥

title.la: Utrum rixa semper sit peccatum
title.zh: 爭門是否常是罪

title.la: Utrum rixa sit filia irae
title.zh: 爭門是否是忿怒的女兒

title.la: De seditione
title.zh: 論叛亂

title.la: Utrum seditio sit speciale peccatum ab aliis distinctum
title.zh: 叛亂是否是一種與眾不同的特別的罪

title.la: Utrum seditio semper sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 叛亂是否常是死罪

title.la: De scandalo
title.zh: 論惡表

title.la: Utrum scandalum convenienter definiatur esse dictum vel factum minus rectum praebens occasionem ruinae
title.zh: 惡表是「提供墮落機會的不大正當的言行」，這個定義是否恰當

title.la: Utrum scandalum sit peccatum
title.zh: 惡表是否是罪

title.la: Utrum scandalum sit speciale peccatum
title.zh: 惡表是否是一種特別的罪

title.la: Utrum scandalum sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 惡表是否是死罪

title.la: Utrum scandalum passivum possit etiam in perfectos cadere
title.zh: 完人是否也會有被動的惡表

title.la: Utrum scandalum activum possit inveniri in viris perfectis
title.zh: 完人是否能有主動的惡表

title.la: Utrum bona spiritualia sint propter scandalum dimittenda
title.zh: 是否為了惡表而應放棄神性之善

title.la: Utrum temporalia sint dimittenda propter scandalum
title.zh: 是否為了惡表而應放棄現世事物

title.la: De praeceptis caritatis
title.zh: 論愛德的誡命

title.la: Utrum de caritate debeat dari aliquod praeceptum
title.zh: 開於愛德是否應該定出什麼誠命

title.la: Utrum de caritate fuerint danda duo praecepta
title.zh: 是否應該定出兩條愛德的誡命

title.la: Utrum sufficiant duo praecepta caritatis
title.zh: 兩條愛德的誠命是否足夠

title.la: Utrum convenienter mandetur quod Deus diligatur ex toto corde
title.zh: 命人應該全心愛天主是否適當

title.la: Utrum super hoc, diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, convenientur addatur, et ex tota anima tua et ex tota fortitudine tua
title.zh: 除了「你當全心愛上主你的天主」之外，再加上「仝靈和全力」'是否適當

title.la: Utrum hoc praeceptum de dilectione Dei possit servari in via
title.zh: 人在世途中是否能遵行這條愛天主的誠命

title.la: Utrum convenienter detur praeceptum de dilectione proximi
title.zh: 愛近人的誠命是否規定得適當

title.la: Utrum ordo caritatis cadat sub praecepto
title.zh: 愛德的次序是否包含在這條誠命裡

title.la: De dono sapientiae
title.zh: 論智慧之恩賜

title.la: Utrum sapientia debeat inter dona Spiritus Sancti computari
title.zh: 智慧是否應被列在聖神的恩賜之間

title.la: Utrum sapientia sit in intellectu sicut in subiecto
title.zh: 智慧是否在理智內如在其主體內

title.la: Utrum sapientia sit practica, sed speculativa tantum
title.zh: 智慧是否只是鑑賞性的，抑或也是實踐性的

title.la: Utrum sapientia possit esse sine gratia, cum peccato mortali
title.zh: 智慧是否能無恩寵且有死罪而存在

title.la: Utrum sapientia sit in omnibus habentibus gratiam
title.zh: 凡有恩寵的人是否都有智慧

title.la: Utrum septima beatitudo respondeat dono sapientiae
title.zh: 第七端真褔是否與智慧之恩賜相配

title.la: De stultitia
title.zh: 論愚笨

title.la: Utrum stultitia opponatur sapientiae
title.zh: 愚笨是否是相反智慧

title.la: Utrum stultitia sit peccatum
title.zh: 愚笨是否是罪

title.la: Utrum stultitia sit filia luxuriae
title.zh: 愚笨是否是迷色的女兒

title.la: De prudentia secundum se
title.zh: 論智德本身

title.la: Utrum prudentia sit in vi cognoscitiva, an in appetitiva
title.zh: 智德是在認識能力內，或是在嗜慾能力內有關一節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum prudentia solum pertineat ad rationem practicam, an etiam ad speculativam
title.zh: 智德是否只屬於實踐的理性，或者也屬於鑑賞的理性

title.la: Utrum prudentia sit cognoscitiva singularium
title.zh: 智德是否認識個別的事物

title.la: Utrum prudentia sit virtus
title.zh: 智是不是德性

title.la: Utrum prudentia sit specialis virtus
title.zh: 智德是不是一種特殊的德性

title.la: Utrum prudentia praestituat finem virtutibus moralibus
title.zh: 智德是否給道德涵養性德性指定目的

title.la: Utrum ad prudentiam pertineat invenire medium in virtutibus moralibus
title.zh: 智德是否給道德涵養性德性找出適宜的中點

title.la: Utrum praecipere sit principalis actus prudentiae
title.zh: 出命是不是智德的主要行動

title.la: Utrum sollicitudo pertineat ad prudentiam
title.zh: 關切是不是屬於智德的事

title.la: Utrum prudentia se extendat ad regimen multitudinis
title.zh: 智德是否擴及管理羣眾

title.la: Utrum prudentia quae est respectu boni proprii sit eadem specie cum ea quae se extendit ad bonum commune
title.zh: 關於個人利益的智德，是否與那關於公眾利益的智德種類相同

title.la: Utrum prudentia sit in subditis, sed solum in principibus
title.zh: 智德是否也在於下屬，或者只是在於上司

title.la: Utrum prudentia possit esse in peccatoribus
title.zh: 罪人是否能有智德

title.la: Utrum prudentia sit in omnibus habentibus gratiam
title.zh: 凡有恩寵的人是否都有智德

title.la: Utrum prudentia insit nobis a natura
title.zh: 我們是否生來就有智德

title.la: Utrum prudentia possit amitti per oblivionem
title.zh: 智德是否可能因遺忘而失去

title.la: De partibus prudentiae
title.zh: 論智德的部分

title.la: Utrum convenienter assignentur partes prudentiae
title.zh: 把智德、分為若干部分是否適當

title.la: De singulis prudentiae partibus quasi integralibus
title.zh: 論智德的各個構成部分

title.la: Utrum memoria sit pars prudentiae
title.zh: 記憶是不是智德的一個部分

title.la: Utrum intellectus sit pars prudentiae
title.zh: 領悟是不是智德的一個部分

title.la: Utrum docilitas debeat poni pars prudentiae
title.zh: 易於受教是否應被視作智德的一個部分

title.la: Utrum solertia sit pars prudentiae
title.zh: 敏捷或機警是不是智德的一個部分

title.la: Utrum ratio debeat poni pars prudentiae
title.zh: 推理是否應被視為智德的一個部分

title.la: Utrum providentia debeat poni pars prudentiae
title.zh: 預見是否應被視為智德的一個部分

title.la: Utrum circumspectio possit esse pars prudentiae
title.zh: 舉目四顧或審慎是否被視為智德的一個部分

title.la: Utrum cautio debeat poni pars prudentiae
title.zh: 慎防是否應被視為智德的一個部分

title.la: De partibus subiectivis prudentiae
title.zh: 論智德的隸屬部分

title.la: Utrum regnativa debeat poni species prudentiae
title.zh: 是否應視君主為智德的一種

title.la: Utrum politica convenienter ponatur pars prudentiae
title.zh: 是否應該視政治為智德的部分

title.la: Utrum oeconomica debeat poni species prudentiae
title.zh: 是否應該視家政為智德的一種

title.la: Utrum militaris debeat poni species prudentiae
title.zh: 是否應該視軍事為智德的一種

title.la: De virtutibus adiunctis prudentiae
title.zh: 論智德的功能部分

title.la: Utrum eubulia sit virtus
title.zh: 審度是不是一種德性

title.la: Utrum eubulia sit virtus distincta a prudentia
title.zh: 審度是不是與智德不同的德、性

title.la: Utrum synesis sit virtus
title.zh: 正常審斷是不是德性

title.la: Utrum gnome sit specialis virtus a synesi distincta
title.zh: 特殊審斷是不是一種特殊的德性

title.la: De dono consilii
title.zh: 論超見之恩賜

title.la: Utrum consilium debeat poni inter dona Spiritus Sancti
title.zh: 是否應該把超見列在聖神之恩賜之間

title.la: Utrum donum consilii respondeat virtuti prudentiae
title.zh: 超見之恩賜是否與智德、相配

title.la: Utrum donum consilii maneat in patria
title.zh: 在天鄉是否仍有超見之恩賜

title.la: Utrum quinta beatitudo, quae est de misericordia, respondeat dono consilii
title.zh: 第五端論憐憫或慈悲的真福，是否與超見之恩賜相配

title.la: De imprudentia
title.zh: 論不智

title.la: Utrum imprudentia sit peccatum
title.zh: 不智是不是罪

title.la: Utrum imprudentia sit speciale peccatum
title.zh: 不智是不是一種特殊的罪

title.la: Utrum praecipitatio sit peccatum sub imprudentia contentum
title.zh: 魯莽是不是一種包括在不智之內的罪

title.la: Utrum inconsideratio sit speciale peccatum sub imprudentia contentum
title.zh: 粗心大意是不是包括在不智之內的一種特殊的罪

title.la: Utrum inconstantia sit vitium sub imprudentia contentum
title.zh: 無恆是不是包括在不智之內的惡習

title.la: Utrum praedicta vitia oriantur ex luxuria
title.zh: 上述諸惡習是否來自迷色

title.la: De negligentia
title.zh: 論疏忽

title.la: Utrum negligentia sit peccatum speciale
title.zh: 疏忽是不是一種特殊的罪

title.la: Utrum negligentia opponatur prudentiae
title.zh: 疏忽是否相反智德有第二節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum negligentia possit esse peccatum mortale
title.zh: 疏忽是否可能是死罪

title.la: De vitiis oppositis prudentiae quae habent similitudinem cum ipsa
title.zh: 論貌似而實相反智德的惡習

title.la: Utrum prudentia carnis sit peccatum
title.zh: 肉性的明智是不是罪

title.la: Utrum prudentia carnis sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 肉性的明智是不是死罪

title.la: Utrum astutia sit speciale peccatum
title.zh: 狡猜是不是一種特殊的罪

title.la: Utrum dolus sit peccatum ad astutiam pertinens
title.zh: 詭計是不是屬於狡滑的罪

title.la: Utrum fraus ad astutiam pertineat
title.zh: 欺詐是否屬於狡獨

title.la: Utrum licitum sit sollicitudinem habere de temporalibus rebus
title.zh: 是否可以關切現世的事物

title.la: Utrum aliquis debeat esse sollicitus in futurum
title.zh: 人是否應該關切將來

title.la: Utrum huiusmodi vitia oriantur ex avaritia
title.zh: 這些惡習是否來自懼吝

title.la: De praeceptis ad prudentiam pertinentibus
title.zh: 論與智德有關的誡命

title.la: Utrum de prudentia fuerit dandum aliquod praeceptum inter praecepta decalogi
title.zh: 在十誠裡是否應有某種有關智德的誠命

title.la: Utrum in veteri lege fuerint convenienter praecepta prohibitiva proposita de vitiis oppositis prudentiae
title.zh: 在舊約的法律裡，關於那些相反智德的惡習所頒布的禁令，是否適當

title.la: De iure
title.zh: 論法

title.la: Utrum ius non sit obiectum iustitiae
title.zh: 法(或合法事物)是不是義德或正義的對象

title.la: Utrum ius convenienter dividatur in ius naturale et ius positivum
title.zh: 將法分為自然法與實證法是否適當

title.la: Utrum ius gentium sit idem cum iure naturali
title.zh: 萬民公法是否與自然法相同

title.la: Utrum debeat specialiter distingui ius paternum et domiminativum
title.zh: 是否應該另外分出父子法和主僕法

title.la: De iustitia
title.zh: 論義德

title.la: Utrum convenienter definiatur quod iustitia est constans et perpetua voluntas ius suum unicuique tribuens
title.zh: 義德為「使各得其所應得的恆常而永久的意志」'這個定義是否適當

title.la: Utrum iustitia semper sit ad alterum
title.zh: 是否義德常是對他人的

title.la: Utrum iustitia sit virtus
title.zh: 義德、或正義是不是德性

title.la: Utrum iustitia sit in voluntate sicut in subiecto
title.zh: 義德是否以意志為其主體

title.la: Utrum iustitia sit virtus generalis
title.zh: 義德是不是普遍性的德性

title.la: Utrum iustitia, secundum quod est generalis, sit idem per essentiam cum omni virtute
title.zh: 以其為普遍性的德性來看，義德、在本質上是否與所有的德性相同

title.la: Utrum sit aliqua iustitia particularis praeter iustitiam generalem
title.zh: 除了普遍的義德之外，是否還有A種個別的義德

title.la: Utrum iustitia particularis habeat materiam specialem
title.zh: 個別的義德是否有一種特殊的質料

title.la: Utrum iustitia sit circa passiones
title.zh: 義德是不是關於惰的

title.la: Utrum medium iustitiae sit medium rei
title.zh: 義德的中道或中點，是不是事物的中道或中點

title.la: Utrum actus iustitiae sit reddere unicuique quod suum est
title.zh: 義德的行為是否在於使各得其所應得有關第十-節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum iustitia praeemineat inter omnes virtutes morales
title.zh: 義德是不是一切道德涵養性德性之首

title.la: De iniustitia
title.zh: 論不義

title.la: Utrum iniustitia sit vitium speciale
title.zh: 不義是不是一種特殊的惡習

title.la: Utrum aliquis dicatur iniustus ex hoc quod facit iniustum
title.zh: 人是否由於行不義之事而被稱為不義之人

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit pati iniustum volens
title.zh: 人是否能自願忍受不義之事

title.la: Utrum quicumque facit iniustum peccet mortaliter
title.zh: 凡行不義者是否都犯死罪

title.la: De iudicio
title.zh: 論判斷

title.la: Utrum iudicium sit actus iustitiae
title.zh: 判斷是不是義德的行為

title.la: Utrum sit licitum iudicare
title.zh: 是否可以判斷

title.la: Utrum iudicium ex suspicione procedens sit illicitum
title.zh: 根據猜疑來判斷是否不可以

title.la: Utrum dubia sint in meliorem partem interpretanda
title.zh: 疑問是否應該加以寬大的解釋

title.la: Utrum sit semper secundum leges scriptas iudicandum
title.zh: 判斷是否常應按照成文法律

title.la: Utrum iudicium per usurpationem reddatur perversum
title.zh: 判斷是否因偕越而為不義

title.la: De partibus iustitiae
title.zh: 論義德的部分

title.la: Utrum convenienter ponatur duae species iustitiae, iustita distributiva et commutativa
title.zh: 將義德分為分配義德與交換義德兩種是否適當

title.la: Utrum medium eodem modo accipiatur in iustitia distributiva et commutativa
title.zh: 是否應以同一方式，確定關於分配義德和交換義德的中點或中道

title.la: Utrum materia utriusque iustitiae sit diversa
title.zh: 兩種義德的質料是否不同

title.la: Utrum iustum sit simpliciter idem quod contrapassum
title.zh: 公正是否與對等的回報絕對相同

title.la: De restitutione
title.zh: 論償還

title.la: Utrum restitutio sit actus iustitiae commutativae
title.zh: 償還是否是交換義德的行為

title.la: Utrum sit necessarium ad salutem quod fiat restitutio eius quod ablatum est
title.zh: 為得救是否必須償還所取走之物

title.la: Utrum sufficiat restituere simplum quod iniuste ablatum est
title.zh: 是否只把不義所取的東西償還就已足夠

title.la: Utrum aliquis debeat restituere quod non abstulit
title.zh: 是否一個人應該償還他所未取的東西

title.la: Utrum oporteat restitutionem facere semper ei a quo acceptum est aliquid
title.zh: 是否常是由誰那裡取走了東西，就必須償還給誰

title.la: Utrum teneatur semper restituere ille qui accepit
title.zh: 是否常是取走東西者必須償還

title.la: Utrum illi qui acceperumt non teneantur restituere
title.zh: 未取得東西者是否也必須償還

title.la: Utrum teneatur aliquis statim restituere, an licite possit restitutionem differre
title.zh: 一個人是否應該立刻償還，或者可以許可他延後償還

title.la: De acceptione personarum
title.zh: 論看情面或對人偏袒

title.la: Utrum personarum acceptio sit peccatum
title.zh: 看情面或對人偏袒是不是罪

title.la: Utrum in dispensatione spiritualium locum habeat personarum acceptio
title.zh: 在分配神性利益時，是否會有對人偏袒的事

title.la: Utrum in exhibitione honoris et reverentiae locum habeat peccatum acceptionis personarum
title.zh: 在表示尊榮和尊敬時，是否會有對人偏袒的罪

title.la: Utrum in iudiciis locum habeat peccatum acceptionis personarum
title.zh: 在審判時，是否會有對人偏袒的罪

title.la: De homicidio
title.zh: 論殺人

title.la: Utrum occidere quaecumque viventia sit illicitum
title.zh: 是不是不可殺死任何生物

title.la: Utrum sit licitum occidere homines peccatores
title.zh: 是否可以殺死罪人

title.la: Utrum occidere hominem peccatorum liceat privatae personae
title.zh: 私人是否可以殺死一個犯罪的人

title.la: Utrum occidere malefactores liceat clericis
title.zh: 聖職人員是否可以殺死作惡的人

title.la: Utrum alicui liceat seipsum occidere
title.zh: 一個人是否可以自殺

title.la: Utrum liceat in aliquo casu interficere innocentum
title.zh: 是否在某種情形下可以殺死無辜的人

title.la: Utrum alicui liceat occidere aliquem se defendendo
title.zh: 一個人是否可以自衛而殺人

title.la: Utrum aliquis casualiter occidens hominem incurrat homicidii reatum
title.zh: 意外殺人者是否應負殺人之罪責

title.la: De peccatis aliarum iniuriarum quae in personam committuntur
title.zh: 論其他侵犯人身的傷害

title.la: Utrum mutilare aliquem membro in aliquo casu possit esse licitum
title.zh: 是否在某種情形下可以斷別人的肢體

title.la: Utrum liceat patribus verberare filios, aut dominis servos
title.zh: 父母打子女或主人打奴僕是否可以

title.la: Utrum liceat aliquem hominem incarcerare
title.zh: 是否可以拘禁人

title.la: Utrum peccatum aggravetur ex hoc quod praedictae iniuriae inferuntur in personas aliis coniunctas
title.zh: 是否因為前述的傷害也波及那些與別人有連帶關{系的人，而罪過更為重大

title.la: De furto et rapina
title.zh: 論偷竊與搶劫

title.la: Utrum naturalis sit homini possessio exteriorum rerum
title.zh: 擁有身外的東西，是否合乎人的本性

title.la: Utrum liceat alicui rem aliquam quasi propriam possidere
title.zh: 人是否可以擁有一些屬於自己的東西

title.la: Utrum sit de ratione furti occulte accipere rem alienam
title.zh: 偷竊的本質是否在於暗中取得別人的東西

title.la: Utrum furtum et rapina sint peccata differentia specie
title.zh: 偷竊與搶劫或強取是不是種類不同的罪

title.la: Utrum furtum semper sit peccatum
title.zh: 偷竊是否常是罪

title.la: Utrum furtum sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 偷竊是不是死罪

title.la: Utrum liceat alicui furari propter necessitatem
title.zh: 迫於急需是否可以偷竊

title.la: Utrum rapina possit fieri sine peccato
title.zh: 是否能發生強取或搶劫而沒有罪

title.la: Utrum furtum sit gravina peccatum quam rapina
title.zh: 偷竊是不是比搶劫罪過更重

title.la: De iniustitia iudicis in iudicando
title.zh: 論法官在審判時所犯的不義

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit iuste iudicare eum qui non est sibi subiectus
title.zh: 一個人是否可以公正地審判一個非其下屬的人

title.la: Utrum iudici liceat iudicare contra veritatem quam novi, propter ea quae in contrarium proponuntur
title.zh: 法官是否可以憑著所提出的相反證據，做出相反自己所知之事實真相的判決

title.la: Utrum iudex possit aliquem iudicare si non sit alius accusator
title.zh: 如無控訴者，法官是否可以審判一個人

title.la: Utrum iudex licite possit poenam relaxare
title.zh: 法官是否可以赦免懲罰

title.la: De his quae pertinent ad iniustam accusationem
title.zh: 論有關不義的控告的事

title.la: Utrum homo tenaetur accusare
title.zh: 人是否必須控告

title.la: Utrum sit necessarium accusationem in scriptis fieri
title.zh: 是否必須用書面控告

title.la: Utrum accusatio reddatur iniusta per calumniam, praevaricationem et tergiversationem
title.zh: 控告是否因誣告、背信舞弊和規避，而變為不義

title.la: Utrum accusator qui in probatione defecerit teneatur ad poenam talionis
title.zh: 未能提出證明的控告者，是否應受報復性的處分

title.la: De peccatis quae sunt contra iustitiam ex parte rei
title.zh: 論被告方面相反義德的罪

title.la: Utrum absque peccato mortali possit accusatus veritatem negare per quam condemnaretur
title.zh: 被告是否可以否認能被判罪的真惰，而不犯死罪

title.la: Utrum accusato liceat calumniose se defendere
title.zh: 被告是否可以用不義的手段為自己辯護

title.la: Utrum reo liceat iudicium declinare per appellationem
title.zh: 被告是否可以利用上訴來迴避審判

title.la: Utrum liceat condemnato ad mortem se defendere, si possit
title.zh: 已被判處死刑的人，可能時是否可以自衛

title.la: De iniustitia pertinente ad personam testis
title.zh: 論關於證人所犯的不義

title.la: Utrum homo teneatur ad testimonium ferendum
title.zh: 人是否必須作證

title.la: Utrum sufficiat duorum vel trium testimonium
title.zh: 兩個或三個人的證供是否足夠

title.la: Utrum alicuius testimonium sit repellendum absque eius culpa
title.zh: 一個人雖然無罪，是否應被拒絕出庭作證

title.la: Utrum falsium testimonium semper sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 作偽證是否常是死罪

title.la: De iniustitia quae fit in iudicio ex parte advocatorum
title.zh: 論審判時律師方面所犯的不義

title.la: Utrum advocatus teneatur patrocium praestare causae pauperum
title.zh: 律師是否必須為窮人的訟事辯誰

title.la: Utrum convenienter aliqui secundum iura arceantur ab officio advocandi
title.zh: 依法禁止某些人執行律師業務是否適當

title.la: Utrum advocatus peccat si iniustam causam defendat
title.zh: 律師是否因為替不公道的訟事辯護而犯罪

title.la: Utrum advocato liceat pro suo patrocinio pecuniam accipere
title.zh: 律師是否可以因替人辯護訟事而接受金錢

title.la: De contumelia
title.zh: 論侮辱

title.la: Utrum contumelia consistat in verbis
title.zh: 悔辱是否在於言語

title.la: Utrum contumelia, seu convicium, sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 侮辱或嘲笑是不是死罪

title.la: Utrum aliquis debeat contumelias sibi illatas sustinere
title.zh: 一個人是否應該容忍加於自己的侮辱

title.la: Utrum contumelia oriatur ex ira
title.zh: 侮辱是否來自忿怒

title.la: De detractione
title.zh: 論誹謗

title.la: Utrum detractio sit denigratio alienae famae per occulta verba
title.zh: 訣謗是不是「私下用言語破壞別人的名譽」

title.la: Utrum detractio sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 訣謗是不是死罪

title.la: Utrum detractio sit gravius omnibus peccatis quae in proximum commituntur
title.zh: 詩謗是不是一切相反近人之罪中最重大的

title.la: Utrum audiens qui tolerat detrahentem graviter peccet
title.zh: 容忍、詩謗者的聽眾是否犯重罪

title.la: De susurratione
title.zh: 論私議

title.la: Utrum susurratio sit peccatum distinctum a detractione
title.zh: 私議是不是一種與排謗不同的罪

title.la: Utrum detractio sit gravius peccatum quam susurratio
title.zh: 排謗是不是比私議更重的罪

title.la: De derisione
title.zh: 論譏笑

title.la: Utrum derisio sit speciale peccatum
title.zh: 譏笑是不是一種特別的罪

title.la: Utrum derisio possit esse peccatum mortale
title.zh: 譏笑是否可能是死罪

title.la: De maledictione
title.zh: 論詛咒

title.la: Utrum liceat maledicere aliquem
title.zh: 是否可以詛咒人

title.la: Utrum liceat creaturam irrationalem maledicere
title.zh: 是否可以詛咒無靈受造物

title.la: Utrum maledicere sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 詛咒是不是死罪

title.la: Utrum maledicere sit gravius peccatum quam detractio
title.zh: 詛咒的罪是不是比說謗的罪更重

title.la: De fraudulentia
title.zh: 論買賣時的欺騙

title.la: Utrum aliquis licite possit vendere rem plus quam valeat
title.zh: 一個人是否可以以高於物值的價錢出售某物

title.la: Utrum venditio reddatur iniusta et illicita propter defectum rei venditae
title.zh: 出售是否因售出之物的缺點，而成為不公道的及不被許可的

title.la: Utrum venditor teneatur dicere vitium rei venditae
title.zh: 賣主是否必須說明所售之物的缺點

title.la: Utrum liceat, negotiando, aliquid carius vendere quam emere
title.zh: 在進行交易時，是否可以以高於買價的價錢出售貨物

title.la: De peccato usurae
title.zh: 論放債之罪

title.la: Utrum accipere usuram pro pecunia mutuata sit peccatum
title.zh: 為借出之金錢而收取利息，是否有罪

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit pro pecunia mutuata aliquam aliam commoditatem expetere
title.zh: 一個人是否可以為了借出之金錢，而索取其他別的利益

title.la: Utrum quidquid aliquis de pecunia usuraria lucratus fuerit, reddere teneatur
title.zh: 一個人是否應該歸還用利息錢所賺取的利潤

title.la: Utrum liceat pecuniam accipere mutuo sub usura
title.zh: 是否可以向人付利借款

title.la: De partibus quasi integralibus iustitiae
title.zh: 論義德的近似構成部分

title.la: Utrum declinare a malo et facere bonum sint partes iustitiae
title.zh: 行善避惡是不是義德的部分

title.la: Utrum transgressio sit speciale peccatum
title.zh: 違犯或輸越是不是一種特殊的罪

title.la: Utrum omissio sit speciale peccatum
title.zh: 失職是不是一種特殊的罪

title.la: Utrum peccatum omissionis sit gravius quam peccatum transgressionis
title.zh: 失職的罪是否重於這犯或愉越的罪

title.la: De partibus potentialibus iustitiae
title.zh: 論義德的功能部分

title.la: Utrum inconvenienter assignentur virtutes iustitiae annexae
title.zh: 附加於義德的德性是否列舉得適當

title.la: De religione
title.zh: 論宗教

title.la: Utrum religio ordinet hominem solum ad Deum
title.zh: 宗教是否導人只指向天主

title.la: Utrum religio sit virtus
title.zh: 宗教是不是德性

title.la: Utrum religio sit una virtus
title.zh: 宗教是否只是一種德性

title.la: Utrum religio sit specialis virtus ab aliis distincta
title.zh: 宗教是不是一種與其他德性不同的特殊德性

title.la: Utrum religio sit virtus theologica
title.zh: 宗教是不是一種向天主之德

title.la: Utrum religio sit praeferenda aliis virtutibus moralibus
title.zh: 宗教是否應比其他道德、福養性德J性更受重視

title.la: Utrum latria habeat aliquem exteriorem actum
title.zh: 對天主的敬禮是否有一些外面的行動

title.la: Utrum religio sit idem sanctitati
title.zh: 宗教與聖善是否相同

title.la: De devotione
title.zh: 論虔誠

title.la: Utrum devotio sit specialis actus
title.zh: 虔誠是不是一種特殊的行為

title.la: Utrum devotio sit actus religionis
title.zh: 虔誠是不是宗教的行為

title.la: Utrum contemplatio, seu meditatio, sit devotionis causa
title.zh: 靜觀或默想是不是虔誠的原因

title.la: Utrum laetitia sit devotionis effectus
title.zh: 喜樂是不是虔誠的效果

title.la: De oratione
title.zh: 論祈禱

title.la: Utrum oratio sit actus appetitivae virtutis
title.zh: 祈禱是不是嗜慾力的行為

title.la: Utrum sit conveniens orare
title.zh: 祈禱是否適宜

title.la: Utrum oratio sit actus religionis
title.zh: 祈禱是不是宗教的行為

title.la: Utrum solus Deus debeat orari
title.zh: 是否應該只向天主祈禱

title.la: Utrum in oratione nihil determinate a Deo petere debeamus
title.zh: 祈禱中我們是否應該向天主請求指定的事物

title.la: Utrum homo debeat temporalia petere a Deo orando
title.zh: 人在祈禱峙，是否應該向天主求暫世的東西

title.la: Utrum debeamus pro aliis orare
title.zh: 我們是否應該為他人祈禱

title.la: Utrum debeamus pro inimicis orare
title.zh: 我們是否應該為仇人祈禱

title.la: Utrum convenienter septem petitiones Orationis Dominicae assignentur
title.zh: 天主經的七項祈求是否排列得適當

title.la: Utrum orare sit proprium rationalis creaturae
title.zh: 祈禱是否為有靈之受造物所特有的

title.la: Utrum sancti qui sunt in patria orent pro nobis
title.zh: 壁人在天鄉是否為我們祈禱

title.la: Utrum oratio debeat esse vocalis
title.zh: 祈禱是否應該口唸

title.la: Utrum de necessitate orationis sit quod sit attenta
title.zh: 注意留神是否為祈禱所必需的

title.la: Utrum oratio debeat esse diuturna
title.zh: 是否應該長時祈禱

title.la: Utrum oratio sit meritoria
title.zh: 祈禱是否有功勞

title.la: Utrum peccatores orando impetrent aliquid a Deo
title.zh: 罪人是否可用祈禱向天主求得什麼

title.la: Utrum convenienter dicantur esse orationis partes obsecrationes, orationes, postulationes, gratiarum actiones
title.zh: 將祈禱分為「懇求、祈禱、要求和謝恩」'是否適當

title.la: De adoratione
title.zh: 論朝拜

title.la: Utrum adoratio sit actus latriae sive religionis
title.zh: 朝拜是不是敬神的或宗教的行為

title.la: Utrum adoratio importet actum corporalem
title.zh: 朝拜是否表示一個肉體的行為

title.la: Utrum adoratio requirat determinatum locum
title.zh: 朝拜是否需要一個確定的地方

title.la: De sacrificiis
title.zh: 論祭祀

title.la: Utrum offerre sacrificium Deo sit de lege naturae
title.zh: 向天主獻祭是否出於自然法律

title.la: Utrum soli summo Deo sit sacrificium offerendum
title.zh: 是否只應該向至高的天主獻祭

title.la: Utrum oblatio sacrificii sit specialis actus virtutis
title.zh: 奉獻祭紀是不是特殊的德性行為

title.la: Utrum omnes teneantur ad sacrificia offerenda
title.zh: 是否人人都必須奉獻祭紀

title.la: De oblationibus et primitiis
title.zh: 論獻儀及初果

title.la: Utrum homines teneantur ad oblationes ex necessitate praecepti
title.zh: 人是否必須根據誠命的要求行獻儀

title.la: Utrum oblationes solum sacerdotibus debeantur
title.zh: 是否只應給司祭行獻儀

title.la: Utrum possit homo oblationes facere de omnibus rebus licite possessis
title.zh: 人是否可以將其任何合法的所有物作為獻儀

title.la: Utrum ad primitias solvendas homines teneantur
title.zh: 人是否必須獻初果

title.la: De decimis
title.zh: 論什一

title.la: Utrum homines teneantur dare decimas ex necessitate praecepti
title.zh: 人是否根據誠命的要求應獻什一

title.la: Utrum de omnibus teneantur homines decimas dare
title.zh: 人是否必須從其全部的所得捐獻什一

title.la: Utrum decimae sint clericis dandae
title.zh: 是否應給神職人員指獻什一

title.la: Utrum etiam clerici teneantur decimas dare
title.zh: 是否神職人員也應該捐獻什一

title.la: De voto
title.zh: 論誓願

title.la: Utrum votum consistat in solo proposito voluntatis
title.zh: 誓願是否只是在於意志的一個主意

title.la: Utrum votum semper debeat fieri de meliori bono
title.zh: 誓願是否常應是關於一件更好的事

title.la: Utrum omne votum obliget ad sui observationem
title.zh: 是否誓願都令人有必須還願的責任

title.la: Utrum expediat aliquid vovere
title.zh: 許願是否有益

title.la: Utrum votum sit actus latriae sive religionis
title.zh: 誓願是不是敬神或宗教的行為

title.la: Utrum magis sit laudabile et meritorium facere aliquid sine voto quam ex voto
title.zh: 沒有誓願而做事，是否比由於誓願而做事，更為可讚及有功勞

title.la: Utrum votum solemnizetur per susceptionem sacri ordinis, et per professionem ad certam regulam
title.zh: 誓願是否因領受聖秩及誓守會規而隆重化

title.la: Utrum illi qui sunt alterius potestati subiecti impediantur a vovendo
title.zh: 屬人權下的人是否不得許願

title.la: Utrum pueri possint voto se obligare ad religionis ingressum
title.zh: 兒童是否可以用誓願來束縛自己去進修會

title.la: Utrum in voto dispensari possit
title.zh: 誓願是否可被免除

title.la: Utrum in voto solemni continentiae possit fieri dispensatio
title.zh: 隆重的貞潔願是否可被免除

title.la: Utrum ad commutationem vel dispensationem voti requiratur praelati auctoritas
title.zh: 更改或免除誓願是否須有神長的權力

title.la: De iuramento
title.zh: 論發誓

title.la: Utrum iurare sit testem Deum invocare
title.zh: 發誓是不是呼號天主作證

title.la: Utrum sit licitum iurare
title.zh: 發誓是否合法

title.la: Utrum convenienter ponantur tres comites iuramenti iustitia, iudicium et veritas
title.zh: 將正義、判斷和真理列為發誓的三附帶條件，是否適當

title.la: Utrum iurare sit actus religionis sive latriae
title.zh: 發誓是不是屬於宗教或敬神的行為

title.la: Utrum iuramentum sit appetendum et frequentandum, tanquam utile et bonum
title.zh: 是否應該欲求並多次發誓，視之為有益的及善的

title.la: Utrum liceat per creaturas iurare
title.zh: 是否可以指受造物發誓

title.la: Utrum iuramentum habeat vim obligandi
title.zh: 誓言是否具有約束力

title.la: Utrum maior sit obligatio iuramenti quam voti
title.zh: 是否誓言比誓願有更大約束力

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit dispensare in iuramento
title.zh: 是否有人能免除誓言

title.la: Utrum iuramentum impediatur per aliquam conditionem personae vel temporis
title.zh: 是否可囡個人或時間的情形而阻止發誓

title.la: De assumptione divini nominis per modum adiurationis
title.zh: 論以誓告方式使用天主聖名

title.la: Utrum liceat hominem adiurare
title.zh: 是否可以誓告人

title.la: Utrum liceat daemones adiurare
title.zh: 是否可以誓告魔鬼

title.la: Utrum liceat adiurare irrationalem creaturam
title.zh: 是否可以誓告無靈受造物

title.la: De assumptione divini nominis ad laudem
title.zh: 論爲讚美高呼而使用天主聖名

title.la: Utrum Deus sit ore laudandus
title.zh: 是否應該用口脣來讚美天主

title.la: Utrum cantus sint assumendi ad laudem divinam
title.zh: 讚美天主是否應用歌唱

title.la: De superstitione
title.zh: 論迷信

title.la: Utrum superstitio sit vitium religioni contrarium
title.zh: 迷信是不是一種相反宗教的惡習

title.la: Utrum sint diversae superstitionis species
title.zh: 迷信是否有不同的種類

title.la: De superstitione indebiti cultus veri Dei
title.zh: 論不適當敬禮真天主的迷信

title.la: Utrum in cultu veri Dei possit esse aliquid perniciosum
title.zh: 敬禮真天主是否能出現有害的事

title.la: Utrum in cultu Dei possit esse aliquid superfluum
title.zh: 敬禮天主是否能出現多餘無謂的事

title.la: De idololatria
title.zh: 論崇拜偶像

title.la: Utrum idololatria recte ponatur species superstitionis
title.zh: 以崇拜偶像為一種迷信是否正確

title.la: Utrum idololatria sit peccatum
title.zh: 崇拜偶像是不是罪

title.la: Utrum idololatria sit gravissimum peccatorum
title.zh: 崇拜偶像是不是最重大的罪

title.la: Utrum causa idololatriae fuerit ex parte hominis
title.zh: 崇拜偶像的原因是不是來自人的方面

title.la: De superstitione divinativa
title.zh: 論占卜的迷信

title.la: Utrum divinatio sit peccatum
title.zh: 佔令是不是罪

title.la: Utrum divinatio sit species superstitionis
title.zh: 佔←是不是一種迷信

title.la: Utrum sit determinare plures divinationis species
title.zh: 是否應該界定數種不同的佔令

title.la: Utrum divinatio quae fit per invocationes Daemonum sit illicita
title.zh: 是否不可以呼求魔鬼以佔←

title.la: Utrum divinatio quae fit per astra sit illicita
title.zh: 是否不可以藉星辰來佔令

title.la: Utrum divinatio quae fit per somnia sit illicita
title.zh: 是否不可以用夢來古←

title.la: Utrum divinatio quae est per auguria et omina et alias huiusmodi observationes exteriorum rerum, sit illicita
title.zh: 是否不可以藉著徵兆、預兆，或者觀察其他這類外面的事物來佔←

title.la: Utrum divinatio sortium sit illicita
title.zh: 是否不可以用拈闢來佔令

title.la: De superstitionibus observantiarum
title.zh: 論遵行的迷信

title.la: Utrum uti observantiis artis notoriae sit illicitum
title.zh: 運用法術守則是否不可以

title.la: Utrum observationes ordinatae ad corporum immutationem, puta ad sanitatem vel ad aliquid huiusmodi, sint licitae
title.zh: 是否可以遵行某些旨在使物體發生變化，如為使身體健康之類的事

title.la: Utrum observationes quae ordinantur ad praecognoscenda aliqua fortunia sunt illicita
title.zh: 是否不可以遵行那些旨在預知吉凶禍福的事

title.la: Utrum suspendere divina verba ad collum sit illicitum
title.zh: 是否不可以頸懸天主的言語

title.la: De tentatione qua Deus tentatur
title.zh: 論試探天主

title.la: Utrum tentatio Dei consistat in aliquibus factis in quibus solius divinae potestatis expectatur effectus
title.zh: 試探天主是否在於一些其效果只需望於天主之神能的行動

title.la: Utrum tentare Deum sit peccatum
title.zh: 試探天主是不是罪

title.la: Utrum tentatio Dei opponatur virtuti religionis
title.zh: 試探天主是否相反宗教之德

title.la: Utrum tentatio Dei sit gravius peccatum quam superstitio
title.zh: 試探天主是否比迷信罪過更重

title.la: De periurio
title.zh: 論假誓

title.la: Utrum falsitas eius quod iuramento confirmatur requiratur ad periurium
title.zh: 假誓是否要求以誓言所保證者必須為假

title.la: Utrum omne periurium sit peccatum
title.zh: 是否所有的假誓都是罪

title.la: Utrum omne periurium sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 是否所有的假誓都是死罪

title.la: Utrum peccet ille qui iniungit iuramentum ei qui periurat
title.zh: 強令發假誓者發誓是否有罪

title.la: De sacrilegio
title.zh: 論褻聖

title.la: Utrum sacrilegium sit sacrae rei violatio
title.zh: 褻聖是不是冒犯聖物

title.la: Utrum sacrilegium sit speciale peccatum
title.zh: 褻聖是不是一種特別的罪

title.la: Utrum species sacrilegii distinguantur secundum res sacras
title.zh: 褻聖是否按照聖物來分類

title.la: Utrum poena sacrilegii debeat esse pecuniaria
title.zh: 是否應該對褻聖處以罰緩

title.la: De simonia
title.zh: 論褻聖交易

title.la: Utrum simonia sit studiosa voluntas emendi et vendendi aliquid spirituale vel spirituali annexum
title.zh: 褻聖交易是不是「刻意買賣神聖之事物，或與神聖之事物有關之東西的意志或意願」

title.la: Utrum semper sit illicitum pro sacramentis pecuniam dare
title.zh: 為了聖事而付錢，是否常是不許可的

title.la: Utrum licitum sit dare et accipere pecuniam pro spiritualibus actibus
title.zh: 為了神聖的行為而授受金錢，是否許可

title.la: Utrum licitum sit pecuniam accipere pro his quae sunt spiritualibus annexa
title.zh: 為了與神聖之事物有關連者而接受金錢，是否許可

title.la: Utrum liceat spiritualia dare pro munere quod est ab obsequio vel a lingua
title.zh: 為了服務或言語方面的問饋，而給人神聖之事物，是否許可

title.la: Utrum sit conveniens simoniaci poena ut privetur eo quod per simoniam acquisivit
title.zh: 剝奪褻聖交易者以褻聖交易所得之事物，是否處罰得當

title.la: De pietate
title.zh: 論孝敬

title.la: Utrum pieta se extendat ad determinatas personas aliquorum hominum
title.zh: 孝敬是不是對某些固定的個人(按: pietas一字，基本上是指孝敬、孝愛，即報本反始的敬和愛，主要是針對天主、父母及祖國而言。由於為人之本者，廣施慈恩於人，此字問而也有慈悲的意義。)

title.la: Utrum pietas exhibeat parentibus sustentationem
title.zh: 是否應該由於孝敬而膽養父母

title.la: Utrum pietas sit specialis virtus ab aliis distincta
title.zh: 孝敬是否為一種與其他德J性不同的特殊{惡性

title.la: Utrum occasione religionis sint praetermittenda pietatis officia in parentes
title.zh: 是否應該為了宗教，而推卸孝敬父母的義務

title.la: De observantia
title.zh: 論尊敬

title.la: Utrum observantia sit specialis virtus ab aliis distincta
title.zh: 尊敬是否為一種與其他德性不同的特殊德性

title.la: Utrum ad observantiam pertinet exhibere cultum et honorem his qui sunt in dignitate constituti
title.zh: 尊敬是否在於向有地位的人表示恭敬和尊重
