title.la: Utrum ea quae in celebratione huius sacramenti aguntur, sunt convenientia
title.zh: 舉行此聖事中的動作是否適宜

title.la: Utrum possit sufficienter occurri defectibus qui circa celebrationem huius sacramenti occurrunt, statuta ecclesiae observando
title.zh: 是否遵守教會規定就足以因應舉行此聖事所出現的缺失

title.la: De sacramento poenitentiae
title.zh: 論告解聖事

title.la: Utrum poenitentia sit sacramentum
title.zh: 告解是不是聖事

title.la: Utrum peccata sint propria materia huius sacramenti
title.zh: 罪是不是此聖事的固有質料

title.la: Utrum haec sit forma huius sacramenti, ‘ego te absolvo’
title.zh: 「我赦免你的罪」是不是此聖事的形式

title.la: Utrum impositio manuum sacerdotis requiratur ad hoc sacramentum
title.zh: 為成就此聖事是否需要司鐸覆手

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum sit de necessitate salutis
title.zh: 此聖事為得救是不是必要的

title.la: Utrum poenitentia sit secunda tabula post naufragium
title.zh: 告解是不是「沉船後的第二救援木板」

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum fuerit convenienter institutum in Nova Lege
title.zh: 在新約法律中建立此聖事是否適宜

title.la: Utrum poenitentia debeat durare usque ad finem vitae
title.zh: 告解是否應該持續至生命結束

title.la: Utrum poenitentia possit esse continua
title.zh: 懺悔是否能連續不斷

title.la: Utrum sacramentum poenitentiae debeat iterari
title.zh: 告解聖事是否應該重複

title.la: De poenitentia secundum quod est virtus
title.zh: 論懺悔之作爲德性

title.la: Utrum poenitentia sit virtus
title.zh: 懺悔是不是德性

title.la: Utrum poenitentia sit specialis virtus
title.zh: 懺悔是不是特殊的德性

title.la: Utrum virtus poenitentiae sit species iustitiae
title.zh: 懺悔之德是不是義德的一種

title.la: Utrum subiectum poenitentiae sit proprie voluntas
title.zh: 懺悔的固有主體是不是意志

title.la: Utrum principium poenitentiae sit ex timore
title.zh: 懺悔的開始是不是出於畏懼

title.la: Utrum poenitentia sit prima virtutum
title.zh: 懺悔是不是為首的德性

title.la: De effectu poenitentiae quantum ad remissionem peccatorum mortalium
title.zh: 論告解在赦免死罪方面的效果

title.la: Utrum per poenitentiam removeantur omnia peccata
title.zh: 告解是否消除一切罪惡

title.la: Utrum sine poenitentia peccatum remitti possit
title.zh: 罪是否能沒有告解獲得赦免

title.la: Utrum possit per poenitentiam unum peccatum sine alio remitti
title.zh: 是否能藉告解赦免一罪而不赦免另一罪

title.la: Utrum remissa culpa per poenitentiam, remaneat reatus poenae
title.zh: 罪過藉告解獲得赦免之後，罪罰是否仍然存留

title.la: Utrum remissa culpa mortali, tollantur omnes reliquiae peccati
title.zh: 死罪的罪過獲得赦免之後，是否罪的一切剩餘部分都被除去

title.la: Utrum remissio culpae sit effectus poenitentiae secundum quod est virtus
title.zh: 赦免罪過是不是，懺悔之德性的效果

title.la: De remissione venialium peccatorum
title.zh: 論小罪的赦免

title.la: Utrum veniale peccatum possit remitti sine poenitentia
title.zh: 小罪是否能沒有懺悔而獲得赦免

title.la: Utrum ad remissionem venialium peccatorum requiratur gratiae infusio
title.zh: 赦免小罪是否需要恩寵的灌輸

title.la: Utrum peccata venialia remittantur per aspersionem aquae benedictae, et episcopalem benedictionem, et alia huiusmodi
title.zh: 小罪是否藉灑聖水、主教降褔及其他類似動作獲得赦免

title.la: Utrum veniale peccatum possit remitti sine mortali
title.zh: 小罪是否能脫離死罪而單獨獲得赦免

title.la: De reditu peccatorum post poenitentiam dimissorum
title.zh: 論在告解後獲得赦免之罪的重返

title.la: Utrum peccata dimissa redeant per sequens peccatum
title.zh: 已獲赦免之罪是否因後來的罪重返

title.la: Utrum peccata dimissa redeant per ingratitudinem quae specialiter est secundum quatuor genera peccatorum
title.zh: 已被赦免之罪是否因忘恩，特別是基於四種罪的忘恩而重現或重返

title.la: Utrum per ingratitudinem peccati sequentis consurgat tantus reatus quantus fuerat peccatorum prius dimissorum
title.zh: 藉由後來之罪的忘恩，是否產生與先前已被赦免諸罪的罪罰等量的罪罰

title.la: Utrum ingratitudo ratione cuius sequens peccatum facit redire peccata prius dimissa, sit speciale peccatum
title.zh: 導致後來的罪使先前已被赦免諸罪重返的忘恩，是不是特殊的罪

title.la: De recuperatione virtutum per poenitentiam
title.zh: 論德性藉告解而恢復

title.la: Utrum per poenitentiam virtutes restituantur
title.zh: 德性是否藉告解復原

title.la: Utrum post poenitentiam resurgat homo in aequali virtute
title.zh: 人告解之後是否在同等的德性中復甦

title.la: Utrum per poenitentiam restituatur homo in pristinam dignitatem
title.zh: 人是否藉告解恢復原有的名分地位

title.la: Utrum opera virtutum in caritate facta mortificari possunt
title.zh: 在愛德中完成的德性的作為或功行，是否能被致死

title.la: Utrum opera mortificata per peccatum per poenitentiam reviviscant
title.zh: 因罪而被致死的作為是否藉告解復甦

title.la: Utrum per poenitentiam subsequentem etiam opera mortua, quae scilicet non sunt in caritate facta, vivificentur
title.zh: 死的作為是否也因後來的告解獲得生命

title.la: De partibus poenitentiae in generali
title.zh: 概論告解的部分

title.la: Utrum poenitentiae debent partes assignari
title.zh: 是否應給告解指定部分

title.la: Utrum convenienter assignentur partes poenitentiae contritio, confessio et satisfactio
title.zh: 指定痛悔、告明和補贖為告解的部分，是否適當

title.la: Utrum praedicta tria sint partes integrales poenitentiae
title.zh: 上述三者是不是告解的構成或整合部分

title.la: Utrum convenienter dividatur poenitentia in poenitentiam ante Baptismum, et poenitentiam mortalium, et poenitentiam venialium
title.zh: 將懺悔分為先於聖洗的懺悔、死罪的懺悔和小罪的懺悔，是否適當

title.la: Supplementum
title.zh: 補編

title.la: De contritione
title.zh: 論痛悔

title.la: Utrum contritio sit dolor pro peccatis assumptus cum proposito confitendi et satisfaciendi
title.zh: 痛悔是不是「因罪惡而自受的附帶告明及補贖之志願的痛苦」

title.la: Utrum contritio sit actus virtutis
title.zh: 痛悔是不是德性的行為

title.la: Utrum attritio possit fieri contritio
title.zh: 下等痛悔是否能成為上等痛悔

title.la: De obiecto contritionis
title.zh: 論痛悔的對象

title.la: Utrum homo debeat conteri de poenis, et non solum de culpa
title.zh: 人是否也應該痛悔罪罰，不只痛悔罪過

title.la: Utrum contritio esse debeat de originali
title.zh: 痛悔是否應該及於原罪

title.la: Utrum de omni actuali peccato commisso a nobis debeamus conteri
title.zh: 我們是否應該痛悔自己所犯的一切罪行或本罪

title.la: Utrum etiam de peccatis futuris aliquis debeat conteri
title.zh: 人是否也應該痛悔將來的罪

title.la: Utrum homo debeat conteri de peccato alieno
title.zh: 人是否應該痛悔他人的罪

title.la: Utrum requiratur de singulis peccatis mortalibus contritio
title.zh: 是否應該分別痛悔每一死罪

title.la: De quantitate contritionis
title.zh: 論痛悔的量或大小

title.la: Utrum contritio sit maior dolor qui esse possit in natura
title.zh: 痛悔是不是自然或本性界所能有的最大痛苦

title.la: Utrum possit esse nimis magnus contritionis dolor
title.zh: 痛悔的痛苦是否能逾分或過大

title.la: Utrum debeat esse maior dolor de uno peccato quam de alio
title.zh: 針對一罪的痛苦，是否能夠大於針對另一罪的痛苦

title.la: De tempore contritionis
title.zh: 論痛悔的時期

title.la: Utrum tota haec vita sit contritionis tempus
title.zh: 是否今生全部都是痛悔時期

title.la: Utrum expediat continue de peccato dolere
title.zh: 是否宜於連續不斷地因罪而痛苦

title.la: Utrum etiam post hanc vitam animae de peccatis conterantur
title.zh: 靈魂在今生之後是否仍然痛悔罪過

title.la: De effectu contritionis
title.zh: 論痛悔的效果

title.la: Utrum peccati remissio sit contritionis effectus
title.zh: 赦免罪過是不是痛悔的效果

title.la: Utrum contritio possit totaliter tollere reatum poenae
title.zh: 痛悔是否能完全除免罪罰

title.la: Utrum contritio parva sufficiat ad deletionem magnorum peccatorum
title.zh: 小痛悔是否足以消滅大罪

title.la: De confessionis necessitate
title.zh: 論告明的必要

title.la: Utrum confessio sit necessaria ad salutem
title.zh: 告明為得救是不是必要的

title.la: Utrum confessio sit de iure naturali
title.zh: 告明是不是源於自然法律

title.la: Utrum omnes ad confessionem teneantur
title.zh: 是否所有的人都有義務告明

title.la: Utrum aliquis licite possit confiteri peccatum quod non habet
title.zh: 人是否可以告明自己所沒有的罪

title.la: Utrum statim teneatur confiteri
title.zh: 是否有義務立即告明

title.la: Utrum possit cum aliquo dispensari ne confiteatur homini
title.zh: 是否能寬免人不向人告明

title.la: De quidditate confessionis
title.zh: 論告明的本質

title.la: Utrum Augustinus convenienter confessionem definiat
title.zh: 奧斯定為告明所下的定義是否適當

title.la: Utrum confessio sit actus virtutis
title.zh: 告明是不是德性的行為

title.la: Utrum confessio sit actus poenitentiae virtutis
title.zh: 告明是不是懺悔的德性行為

title.la: De ministro confessionis
title.zh: 論爲告明服務的聖職人員或施行人

title.la: Utrum sit necessarium sacerdoti confiteri
title.zh: 是否必須向司鐸告明

title.la: Utrum in aliquo casu liceat aliis quam sacerdotibus confiteri
title.zh: 是否許可在某種情況下，向司鐸以外的其他人告明

title.la: Utrum, extra casum necessitatis, possit aliquis non sacerdos confessionem venialium audire
title.zh: 在非緊急情況下，不是司鐸者是否能聽人告明小罪

title.la: Utrum sit necessarium quod homo confiteatur proprio sacerdoti
title.zh: 是否必須向本人所屬司鐸告明

title.la: Utrum possit aliquis alteri quam proprio sacerdoti confiteri ex privilegio vel mandato superioris
title.zh: 基於特許或上司的命令，人是否能向本人所屬司鐸之外的其他司鐸告明

title.la: Utrum in fine vitae poenitens possit a quolibet sacerdote absolvi
title.zh: 懺悔者在生命的最後時刻，是否能由任何司鐸獲得赦罪

title.la: Utrum poena temporalis, cuius reatus post poenitentiam manet, taxetur secundum quantitatem culpae
title.zh: 是否應該根據罪過的量或大小'來評定告解之後仍需承受的暫罰

title.la: De qualitate confessionis
title.zh: 論告明的性質

title.la: Utrum confessio possit esse informis
title.zh: 告明能否是未成形的

title.la: Utrum oporteat confessionem esse integram
title.zh: 告明是否應該是完整的

title.la: Utrum possit per alium, quis confiteri, vel per scriptum
title.zh: 是否能藉由另一人或書面告明

title.la: Utrum illae sexdecim conditiones quae a magistris assignantur, requirantur ad confessionem
title.zh: 告明是否需要滿全教師們所提出的十六條件

title.la: De effectu confessionis
title.zh: 論告明的效果

title.la: Utrum confessio liberet a morte peccati
title.zh: 告明是否解除罪的死亡

title.la: Utrum confessio liberet aliquo modo a poena
title.zh: 告明是否以某種方式或程度解除懲罰

title.la: Utrum confessio aperiat paradisum
title.zh: 告明是否開啟樂園或天堂

title.la: Utrum effectus confessionis poni debeat quod tribuit spem salutis
title.zh: 是否應該把「賜予得救的希望」列為告明的效果

title.la: Utrum confessio generalis sufficiat ad delendum peccata mortalia oblita
title.zh: 一般告明是否足以消滅被遺忘的死罪

title.la: De sigillo confessionis
title.zh: 論告解的祕密

title.la: Utrum in quolibet casu teneatur sacerdos celare peccata quae sub sigillo confessionis novit
title.zh: 告解司釋是不是在任何情況下，都不應該洩露從告解的祕密中得知的罪過

title.la: Utrum sigillum confessionis se extendat ad alia quam illa quae sunt de confessione
title.zh: 告解祕密的封存，是否涵蓋告明以外的消息

title.la: Utrum solum sacerdos sigillum confessionis habeat
title.zh: 是否唯有告解司鐸該保守告解的祕密

title.la: Utrum de licentia confitentis possit sacerdos peccatum quod habet sub sigillo confessionis, alteri prodere
title.zh: 告解司鐸因告解人的同意，是否能洩漏從告解他密中得知的罪過

title.la: Utrum illud quod quis scit per confessionem et etiam alio modo, possit alteri revelare
title.zh: 告解司鐸藉著告解同時，又以其它方法知道的同一罪過，是否能洩露於人

title.la: De satisfactione
title.zh: 論補贖

title.la: Utrum satisfactio sit virtus, vel actus virtutis
title.zh: 補贖是不是德性或德性的行為

title.la: Utrum satisfactio sit actus iustitiae
title.zh: 補贖是否是正義的行為

title.la: Utrum definitio satisfactionis in littera convenienter ponatur ab Augustino
title.zh: 奧斯定《證道集》是否提出補贖的適宜定義

title.la: De possibilitate satisfactionis
title.zh: 論補贖的可能性

title.la: Utrum homo possit Deo satisfacere
title.zh: 人是否可能補償天主

title.la: Utrum poenam satisfactoriam possit unus pro alio explere
title.zh: 是否可能為他人做補贖

title.la: De qualitate satisfactionis
title.zh: 論補贖的品質

title.la: Utrum homo possit de uno peccato sine alio satisfacere
title.zh: 人是否可能補贖這個罪而不補贖那個罪

title.la: Utrum aliquis de peccatis prius dimissis satisfacere possit extra caritatem existens
title.zh: 無愛德的人是否可能補贖先前因痛悔已赦免的罪過

title.la: Utrum, postquam homo caritatem habuerit, valere incipiat satisfactio praecedens
title.zh: 人之後有了愛德，先前的補贖是否開始生效

title.la: Utrum opera extra caritatem facta sint alicuius boni meritoria, saltem temporalis
title.zh: 凡無愛德之人所行的善工，是否至少有些暫時性的功績

title.la: Utrum opera praedicta valeant ad poenae infernalis mitigationem
title.zh: 上述的善工是否有益於減輕地獄的罪罰

title.la: De his per quae satisfactio fit
title.zh: 論補贖的方法

title.la: Utrum satisfactionem oporteat fieri per opera poenalia
title.zh: 補贖是否必須是告解司鐸所罰的善工

title.la: Utrum flagella quibus a Deo in hac vita punimur, possint satisfactoria esse
title.zh: 我們在現世受天主的懲罰，是否可能贖罪

title.la: Utrum convenienter enumerentur opera satisfactoria, cum dicitur quod sunt tria: eleemosyna, ieiunium et oratio
title.zh: 補贖善工是否適宜地列為三種:哀矜、守齋與祈禱

title.la: De suscipientibus hoc sacramentum
title.zh: 論告解聖事的領受人

title.la: Utrum in innocentibus poenitentia esse possit
title.zh: 無辜者是否可能有懺悔

title.la: Utrum sancti homines qui sunt in gloria, habeant poenitentiam
title.zh: 那些在光榮中的聖人是否有懺悔

title.la: Utrum etiam angelus, bonus seu malus, sit susceptivus poenitentiae
title.zh: 天使或魔鬼是否可能有懺悔

title.la: De clavibus ecclesiae
title.zh: 論教會的鑰匙

title.la: Utrum claves in Ecclesia esse debeant
title.zh: 教會是不是應該有鑰匙

title.la: Utrum clavis sit potestas ligandi et solvendi
title.zh: 鑰匙是否是束縛和釋放的權柄

title.la: Utrum sint duae claves, vel tantum una
title.zh: 鑰匙是否有兩把，或只是一把

title.la: De effectu clavium
title.zh: 論鑰匙的效果

title.la: Utrum potestas clavium se extendat ad remissionem culpae
title.zh: 鑰匙的權柄是否包括罪過的赦免

title.la: Utrum sacerdos possit remittere peccatum quoad poenam
title.zh: 司鐸是否能赦免罪罰

title.la: Utrum sacerdos per potestatem clavium ligare possit
title.zh: 司鐸是否能藉著鑰匙的權柄而束縛

title.la: Utrum sacerdos possit ligare et solvere secundum proprium arbitrium
title.zh: 司鐸是否能自由地束縛和釋放

title.la: De ministris clavium et usu earum
title.zh: 論鑰匙的管理者及運用

title.la: Utrum sacerdos legalis claves habuerit
title.zh: 舊約的司祭是不是有鑰匙

title.la: Utrum Christus habuerit elavem
title.zh: 基督是否有鑰匙

title.la: Utrum soli sacerdotes claves habeant
title.zh: 是否唯有司鋒纔有鑰匙

title.la: Utrum sancti homines non sacerdotes usum clavium habeant
title.zh: 非司鐸的聖人們是否也有論匙

title.la: Utrum mali sacerdotes usum clavium habeant
title.zh: 惡司鐸是否能使用鑰匙

title.la: Utrum schismatici et haeretici, excommunicati et suspensi et degradati, usum clavium habeant
title.zh: 裂教的、異端教的、受絕罰的、停職的和被撤職的司鐸'是否能運用鑰匙

title.la: De his in quos usus clavium exerceri potest
title.zh: 論鑰匙權用於何人

title.la: Utrum sacerdos possit uti clave quam habet in quemlibet hominem
title.zh: 司鐸是不是能對任何人行使鑰匙的權柄

title.la: Utrum sacerdos possit semper suum subditum absolvere
title.zh: 司祭是否總是能赦免自己屬下的罪過

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit uti clavibus in suum superiorem
title.zh: 司鐸是否能對自己的上司行使鑰匙的權柄

title.la: De excommunicatione
title.zh: 論絕罰

title.la: Utrum competens sit haec definitio excommunicationis: excommunicatio est separatio a communione Ecclesiae quoad fructum et suffragia generalia
title.zh: 將「絕罰」定義成「與教會共融的果實和普遍救助的隔離」'是否適當

title.la: Utrum Ecclesia aliquem debeat excommunicare
title.zh: 教會是否應該絕罰人

title.la: Utrum aliquis pro temporali damno debeat excommunicari
title.zh: 人是否應該因現世傷害而受絕罰

title.la: Utrum excommunicatio iniuste lata aliquo modo effectum habeat
title.zh: 宣判不公正的絕罰是否也產生效力

title.la: De his qui possunt excommunicare et excommunicari
title.zh: 論施絕罰者與受絕罰者

title.la: Utrum quilibet sacerdos possit excommunicare
title.zh: 每位司鐸是否都能絕罰人

title.la: Utrum non-sacerdotes excommunicare possint
title.zh: 非司鐸是否能絕罰人

title.la: Utrum excommunicatus vel suspensus excommunicare possit
title.zh: 受絕罰者或停職者是否能絕罰人

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit seipsum, vel aequalem vel superiorem excommunicare
title.zh: 司鐸是否能絕罰自己或自己的平費或長輩

title.la: Utrum in aliquam universitatem sententia excommunicationis ferri possit
title.zh: 團體是否能被宣判受絕罰

title.la: Utrum ille qui semel est excommunicatus, ulterius excommunicari possit
title.zh: 那已受絕罰的人是否能再受絕罰

title.la: De participatione cum excommunicatis
title.zh: 論人與受絕罰者的交往

title.la: Utrum liceat excommunicato communicare in pure corporalibus
title.zh: 人與受絕罰者在純粹肉身方面事務的交往是否合法

title.la: Utrum participans excommunicato sit excommunicatus
title.zh: 與受絕罰者交往是否受絕罰

title.la: Utrum participare cum excommunicato in casibus non concessis semper sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 與受絕罰者交往是否總是犯大罪

title.la: De absolutione ab excommunicatione
title.zh: 論赦免絕罰

title.la: Utrum quilibet sacerdos subditum suum possit ab excommunicatione absolvere
title.zh: 任何司鐸是否都能赦免自己屬下的絕罰

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit absolvi invitus
title.zh: 司鐸是否能赦免不願意絕罰得赦的人

title.la: Utrum aliquis possit absolvi ab una excommunicatione sine hoc quod absolvatur ab omnibus
title.zh: 人是否能得赦一種絕罰而不得赦一切絕罰

title.la: De indulgentia
title.zh: 論大赦

title.la: Utrum per indulgentiam possit aliquid remitti de poena satisfactoria
title.zh: 大赦是不是能赦免部分的罪罰

title.la: Utrum indulgentiae valeant tantum quantum pronuntiantur
title.zh: 大赦的效果是否與所宣告者相同

title.la: Utrum pro temporali subsidio debeat fieri indulgentia
title.zh: 為現世的救助是否該放大赦

title.la: De his qui possunt indulgentias facere
title.zh: 論頒佈大赦者

title.la: Utrum quilibet sacerdos parochialis possit indulgentias facere
title.zh: 每位堂區的主任司鐸是否都能頒布大赦

title.la: Utrum diaconus possit indulgentias facere, vel alius non-sacerdos
title.zh: 六品或其他非司鐸是否能頒布大赦

title.la: Utrum episcopus possit indulgentias facere
title.zh: 主教是否能頒布大赦

title.la: Utrum ille qui est in peccato mortali possit facere indulgentias
title.zh: 有大罪的人是否能頒布大赦

title.la: De his quibus valet indulgentia
title.zh: 論得大赦者

title.la: Utrum indulgentia valeat existentibus in peccato mortali
title.zh: 大赦是否有益於有大罪的人

title.la: Utrum indulgentiae valeant religiosis
title.zh: 大赦是否有益於會士

title.la: Utrum ei qui non facit hoc pro quo indulgentia datur, possit quandoque indulgentia dari
title.zh: 那未履行得大赦所需要的條件者，是否有時能得大赦

title.la: Utrum indulgentia valeat ei qui facit
title.zh: 大赦是否有益於頒發大赦者

title.la: De solemnitate poenitentiae
title.zh: 論告解聖事的隆重補贖禮儀

title.la: Utrum debeat aliqua poenitentia publicari vel solemnizari
title.zh: 補贖是否應該公開或舉行隆重禮儀

title.la: Utrum solemnis poenitentia iterari possit
title.zh: 隆重的補贖是否可以重複

title.la: Utrum sit conveniens ritus solemnis poenitentiae imponenda mulieribus et clericis, et a quolibet sacerdote possit imponi
title.zh: 隆重補贖的禮儀是否合適

title.la: De sacramento extremae unctionis
title.zh: 論終傅聖事

title.la: Utrum extrema unctio sit sacramentum
title.zh: 終傅是不是聖事

title.la: Utrum extrema unctio sit unum sacramentum
title.zh: 終傅是否是一件聖事

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum institutum a Christo fuerit
title.zh: 這件聖事是否是基督親立的

title.la: Utrum oleum olivae sit conveniens materia huius sacramenti
title.zh: 橄欖油是否是這件聖事的質料

title.la: Utrum oporteat esse oleum consecratum
title.zh: 終傅聖油是否必須被祝聖

title.la: Utrum oporteat materiam huius sacramenti esse consecratam per episcopum
title.zh: 這件聖事的質料是否必須是主教祝聖的

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum habeat aliquam formam
title.zh: 這件聖事是否有形式

title.la: Utrum forma huius sacramenti debeat proferri per orationem indicativam, et non deprecativam
title.zh: 這件聖事的形式是否應該是敘述性，而不是祈求性的經文

title.la: Utrum praedicta oratio sit competetis forma huius sacramenti
title.zh: 上述的經文是否是這件聖事的適當形式

title.la: De effectu sacramenti extremae unctionis
title.zh: 論終傅聖事的效果

title.la: Utrum extrema unctio valeat ad remissionem peccatorum
title.zh: 終傅聖事是否有益於罪過的赦免

title.la: Utrum sanitas corporalis sit effectus huius sacramenti
title.zh: 身體的健康是否是這件聖事的效果

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum imprimat characterem
title.zh: 這件聖事是否賦予神印

title.la: De ministro sacramenti extremae unctionis
title.zh: 論終傅聖事的施行人

title.la: Utrum etiam laicus possit hoc sacramentum conferre
title.zh: 教友是否也能施行這件聖事關於第一節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum diaconi possint hoc sacramentum conferre
title.zh: 六品是否能施行這件聖事

title.la: Utrum solus episcopus possit hoc sacramentum conferre
title.zh: 是否唯有主教才能施行這件聖事

title.la: De his quibus sacramentum extremae unctionis conferri debeat, et in qua parte corporis
title.zh: 論終傅聖事的領受人與英國受傅的肢體

title.la: Utrum sanis conferri debeat hoc sacramentum
title.zh: 身體健康的人是否也應該領受這件聖事

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum dari debeat in qualibet infirmitate
title.zh: 患任何病症的人是否都應該領受這件聖事

title.la: Utrum furiosis et amentibus hoc sacramentum dari debeat
title.zh: 喪失心智與智能不足者，是否應該領受這件聖事

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum debeat dari pueris
title.zh: 兒童是否應該領受這件聖事

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramento totum corpus inungi debeat
title.zh: 整個身體是否都應該傅油

title.la: Utrum convenienter determinentur partes ungendae
title.zh: 是否適宜地規定應受傅泊的肢體

title.la: Utrum mutilati sint ungendi illis unctionibus quae partibus illis competunt
title.zh: 身體傷殘的人們是否應在規定的肢體上傅油

title.la: De iteratione sacramenti extremae unctionis
title.zh: 論終傅聖事的重複

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum debeat iterari
title.zh: 這件聖事是否應該重複施行

title.la: Utrum in eadem infirmitate debeat iterari
title.zh: 同一個病是否應該重複施行絡傳聖事

title.la: De sacramento ordinis
title.zh: 論神品聖事

title.la: Utrum ordo in Ecclesia esse debeat
title.zh: 教會是否應該有神品聖事

title.la: Utrum convenienter ordo a Magistro Sententiarum definiatur
title.zh: 大師〈語錄〉對神品聖事所下的定義是否適宜

title.la: Utrum ordo sit sacramentum
title.zh: 神品是否是聖事

title.la: Utrum forma huius sacramenti convenienter in littera exprimatur
title.zh: 大師〈語錄〉是否適宜地說明這件聖事的形式

title.la: Utrum hoc sacramentum habeat materiam
title.zh: 這件聖事是否有質料

title.la: De effectu sacramenti ordinis
title.zh: 論神品聖事的效果

title.la: Utrum in sacramento ordinis conferatur gratia gratum facietis
title.zh: 神品聖事是不是賦予寵愛

title.la: Utrum in sacramento ordinis imprimatur character quantum ad omnes ordines
title.zh: 神品中的一切品級是否都有神印

title.la: Utrum character ordinis praesupponat characterem baptismalem
title.zh: 神品聖事的神印是否必須先有聖洗聖事的神印

title.la: Utrum character ordinis praesupponat de necessitate characterem confirmationis
title.zh: 神品聖事的神印是否必須先有堅振聖事的神印

title.la: Utrum character unius ordinis praesupponat de necessitate characterem alterius ordinis
title.zh: 這一品級的神印是否必須先有那一品級的神印

title.la: De qualitate suscipientium hoc sacramentum
title.zh: 論領受神品聖事者的資格

title.la: Utrum in suscipientibus ordines requiratur bonitas vitae
title.zh: 領受神品聖事的人，是否需要聖善的生活

title.la: Utrum in suscipientibus ordines requiratur scientia totius sacrae Scripturae
title.zh: 領受神品聖事的人，是否需要全部聖經的知識

title.la: Utrum ex ipso merito vitae aliquis ordinis gradus consequatur
title.zh: 人是否因修德立功的生活而獲得品級

title.la: Utrum promovens indignos ad ordines peccet
title.zh: 授予不合格者神品的人是否犯罪

title.la: Utrum aliquis in peccato existens possit sine peccato ordine suscepto uti
title.zh: 有罪的人行使他所領受的神品是否能無罪

title.la: De distinctione ordinum, et eorum actibus, et characteris impressione
title.zh: 論神品的區分、行爲與神印

title.la: Utrum debeant plures ordines distingui
title.zh: 是否應該分為許多神品

title.la: Utrum sint septem ordines
title.zh: 神品是否有七種品級

title.la: Utrum ordines debeant distingui per sacros et non sacros
title.zh: 神品是否應該分為神品與非神品

title.la: Utrum actus ordinum convenienter in littera assignentur
title.zh: 大師的〈語錄〉對神品行為的區分是否適當

title.la: Utrum sacerdoti character imprimatur in ipsa calicis porrectione
title.zh: 神品神印是否是在主教授予聖爵時賦予

title.la: De conferentibus hoc sacramentum
title.zh: 論神品聖事的施行人

title.la: Utrum tantum episcopus ordinis sacramentum conferat
title.zh: 是否唯有主教才能施行神品聖事關於第一節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum haeretici et ab Ecclesia praecisi possint ordines conferre
title.zh: 異端和脫離教會的主教是否能授予神品

title.la: De impedimentis huius sacramenti
title.zh: 論神品聖事的限制

title.la: Utrum sexus femineus impediat ordinis susceptionem
title.zh: 女性是否有領受神品的限制

title.la: Utrum pueri, et qui carent usu rationis, possint ordines suscipere
title.zh: 兒童和無識別能力者，是否能領受神品

title.la: Utrum servitus impediat aliquem a susceptione ordinum
title.zh: 奴隸的身份是否是領受神品的限制

title.la: Utrum propter homicidium aliquis debeat prohiberi a sacris ordinibus
title.zh: 人是否因殺人而應該被禁止領受神品

title.la: Utrum illegitime nati debeant impediri a susceptione ordinum
title.zh: 非婚生的兒子是否應該被禁止領受神品

title.la: Utrum propter defectum membrorum debeat aliquis impediri
title.zh: 人是否應該因肢體不全而被禁止領受神品

title.la: De his quae sunt annexa sacramento ordinis
title.zh: 論與神品聖事有關的問題

title.la: Utrum ordinati debeant coronae rasuram deferre
title.zh: 領受神品者是否應該行剪髮禮

title.la: Utrum corona sit ordo
title.zh: 剪髮禮是否是一種聖秩品位

title.la: Utrum per acceptionem coronae aliquis renuntiet temporalibus bonis
title.zh: 領受剪髮禮者，是否應該棄絕現世的財富

title.la: Utrum supra sacerdotalem ordinem debeat esse aliqua potestas episcopalis
title.zh: 在教會肉，鐸品之上是否還應該有主教的權柄

title.la: Utrum episcopatus sit ordo
title.zh: 主教品是否是神品

title.la: Utrum supra episcopos possit esse aliquis superior in Ecclesia
title.zh: 教會是否能有主教之上的權柄

title.la: Utrum vestes ministrorum convenienter sint in Ecclesia institutae
title.zh: 教會是否適宜地規定神職人員的服裝

title.la: De matrimonio inquantum est in officium naturae
title.zh: 論婚姻的自然功能

title.la: Utrum matrimonium sit naturale
title.zh: 婚姻是否屬於自然律

title.la: Utrum matrimonium adhuc maneat sub praecepto
title.zh: 婚姻是否屬於法令範固

title.la: Utrum actus matrimonialis semper sit peccatum
title.zh: 房事是否總有罪過

title.la: Utrum actus matrimonialis sit meritorius
title.zh: 房事是否有功勞

title.la: De matrimonio inquantum est sacramentum
title.zh: 論婚姻聖事

title.la: Utrum matrimonium sit sacramentum
title.zh: 婚姻是不是聖事

title.la: Utrum matrimonium debuerit institui ante peccatum
title.zh: 婚姻聖事是否應該在原祖犯罪以前建立關於第二節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum matrimonium conferat gratiam
title.zh: 婚姻聖事是否賦予恩寵

title.la: Utrum carnalis commixtio sit de integritate matrimonii
title.zh: 性交是否屬於婚姻聖事的完整

title.la: De sponsalibus
title.zh: 論婚約

title.la: Utrum sponsalia convenienter dicantur futurarum nuptiarum promissio
title.zh: 將訂婚定義為「對未來婚姻的諾言」'是否適宜

title.la: Utrum tempus septennii sit competenter assignatum sponsalibus contrahendis
title.zh: 訂婚者的最低法定年齡是七歲，是否適宜

title.la: Utrum sponsalia dirimi possint
title.zh: 訂婚的婚約是否能被解除

title.la: De matrimonii definitione
title.zh: 論婚姻的定義

title.la: Utrum matrimonium sit in genere coniunctionis
title.zh: 婚姻是不是一種結合

title.la: Utrum matrimonium congrue nominetur
title.zh: 稱為婚姻是否適宜

title.la: Utrum matrimonium convenienter definiatur in littera
title.zh: 〈語錄〉是否適宜地為婚姻下定義

title.la: De consensu matrimonii
title.zh: 論婚姻的合意

title.la: Utrum consensus sit causa efficiens matrimonii
title.zh: 合意是否是構成婚姻的成因

title.la: Utrum oporteat consensum per verba exprimi
title.zh: 合意是否必須以言語來表達

title.la: Utrum consensus expressus per verba de futuro matrimonium faciat
title.zh: 許諾未來之事的合意是否構成結婚

title.la: Utrum consensus expressio, etiam per verba, si desit interior consensus, faciat matrimonium
title.zh: 無內心贊成的口頭合意是否也構成婚姻

title.la: Utrum consensus in occulto factus per verba de praesenti faciat matrimonium
title.zh: 對現在之事祕密的合意，是否構成結婚

title.la: De consensu cui advenit iuramentum vel copula carnalis
title.zh: 論誓願或性行爲所增加的合意

title.la: Utrum iuramentum adiunctum consensui per verba de futuro expresso, faciat matrimonium
title.zh: 在婚約的許諾之後加上誓願'是否構成婚姻

title.la: Utrum carnalis copula, post verba de futuro consensum exprimentia, faciat matrimonium
title.zh: 合意之後的性行為是否構成婚姻

title.la: De consensu coacto et conditionato
title.zh: 論被迫及有條件的合意

title.la: Utrum aliquis consensus possit esse coactus
title.zh: 合意是否可能是被迫的

title.la: Utrum coactio metus cadat in constantem virum
title.zh: 恐懼的威脅是否能夠強迫堅強的男人

title.la: Utrum consensus coactus tollat matrimonium
title.zh: 被迫的合意是否使婚姻無效

title.la: Utrum consensus coactus saltem ex parte cogentis faciat matrimonium
title.zh: 被迫的合意是否為施迫者構成婚姻

title.la: Utrum per consensum conditionatum fiat matrimonium
title.zh: 有條件的合意是否構成婚姻

title.la: Utrum aliquis praecepto patris possit compelli ad matrimonium contrahendum
title.zh: 兒子是否能因父親的命令而被迫結婚

title.la: De obiecto consensus
title.zh: 論合意的對象

title.la: Utrum consensus qui facit matrimonium sit consensus in carnalem copulam
title.zh: 構成結婚的合意是否指向肉身的結合

title.la: Utrum matrimonium possit esse ex consensu alicuius in aliquam propter causam inhonestam
title.zh: 為了不正當的理由所做的合意，是否構成婚姻

title.la: De bonis matrimonii
title.zh: 論婚姻的利益

title.la: Utrum matrimonium debeat habere aliqua bona quibus excusetur
title.zh: 婚姻是不是該有些利益纔可容忍

title.la: Utrum sufficienter bona matrimonii assignentur a Magistro Sententiarum: scilicet fides, proles et sacramentum
title.zh: 大師〈語錄〉所列舉的婚姻利益是否充足

title.la: Utrum sacramentum sit principalius inter bona matrimonii
title.zh: 聖事是否是婚姻的主要利益

title.la: Utrum actus matrimonii possit excusari per bona praedicta ut non sit omnino peccatum
title.zh: 上述的利益是否能使房事毫無罪過

title.la: Utrum actus matrimonialis excusari possit etiam sine bonis matrimonii
title.zh: 房事若無婚姻的利益，是否能夠被諒解

title.la: Utrum quandocumque aliquis uxorem cognoscit non intendens aliquod bonum matrimonii sed solam delectationem, mortaliter peccet
title.zh: 那不為婚姻利益但只為快樂而同妻子性交，是否犯大罪

title.la: De impedimentis matrimonii in generali
title.zh: 泛論婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum matrimonio convenienter impedimenta assignentur
title.zh: 婚姻是否適宜地規定限制

title.la: De impedimento erroris
title.zh: 論錯誤的限制

title.la: Utrum error debeat poni matrimonii impedimentum per se
title.zh: 錯誤是不是應該被列為婚姻的本來限制

title.la: Utrum omnis error matrimonium impediat
title.zh: 一切的錯誤是否都是婚姻的限制

title.la: De impedimento conditionis servitutis
title.zh: 論奴役身份的限制

title.la: Utrum conditio servitutis impediat matrimonium
title.zh: 奴役的身份是不是婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum servus matrimonium contrahere possit sine consensu domini
title.zh: 奴隸沒有主人的同意，是否能結婚

title.la: Utrum servitus matrimonio possit supervenire, ut vir se alteri in servum vendat
title.zh: 在婚後，丈夫是否能賣身為奴

title.la: Utrum filii debeant sequi conditionem patris
title.zh: 兒女是否應該承襲父親的身份

title.la: De impedimento voti et ordinis
title.zh: 論聖願與神品的限制

title.la: Utrum per obligationem voti simplicis matrimonium contractum dirimi debeat
title.zh: 婚姻是否因普通聖願的義務而應該被拆散

title.la: Utrum votum solemne dirimat matrimonium iam contractum
title.zh: 特級聖願是否拆散已締結的婚姻

title.la: Utrum ordo impediat matrimonium
title.zh: 神品是否是婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum matrimonio ordo sacer supervenire possit
title.zh: 婚後能否領受神品

title.la: De impedimento consanguinitatis
title.zh: 論血親關係的限制

title.la: Utrum definitio consanguinitatis, quam quidam ponunt, sit competens
title.zh: 血親關{系的定義是否適當

title.la: Utrum consanguinitas convenienter distinguatur per lineas et gradus
title.zh: 血親關係是否適宜地分為血統與親等

title.la: Utrum consanguinitas de iure naturali impediat matrimonium
title.zh: 按自然律，血親關係是否是婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum consanguinitatis gradus matrimonium impedientes potuerint taxari ab Ecclesia usque ad quartum gradum
title.zh: 限制婚姻的血親關{系，教會能否規定為四等

title.la: De impedimento affinitatis
title.zh: 論姻親關係的限制

title.la: Utrum ex matrimonio consanguinei affinitas causetur
title.zh: 血親的婚姻是不是產生姻親關係

title.la: Utrum affinitas maneat post mortem viri inter consanguineos viri et uxorem
title.zh: 丈夫死後，他的血親與妻子之間的姻親關係是否存在

title.la: Utrum illicitus concubitus affinitatem causet
title.zh: 違法的性交是否產生姻親閱(系

title.la: Utrum ex sponsalibus aliqua affinitas causari possit
title.zh: 婚約是否能產生姻親關係

title.la: Utrum affinitas sit causa affinitatis
title.zh: 姻親關{系是否是另一姻親關{系的原因

title.la: Utrum affinitas matrimonium impediat
title.zh: 姻親關{系是否是婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum affinitas habeat etiam per seipsam gradus
title.zh: 姻親闊係本身是否也有親等

title.la: Utrum gradus affinitatis extendantur sicut gradus consanguinitatis
title.zh: 姻親關{系的親等與血親關l系的親等是否相同

title.la: Utrum coniugium quod inter affines vel consanguineos est contractum, semper sit per divortium dirimendum
title.zh: 姻親或血親的婚姻是否總是應該離婚

title.la: Utrum ad separationem matrimonii quod est inter affines et consanguineos contractum, sit procedendum per viam accusationis
title.zh: 姻親與血親的離婚是否應該經過控訴

title.la: Utrum in tali causa sit procedendum per testes, sicut in aliis causis
title.zh: 這種案件是否像其它案件該有證人

title.la: De impedimento cognationis spiritualis
title.zh: 論神親的限制

title.la: Utrum spiritualis cognatio matrimonium impediat
title.zh: 神親是不是婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum per solum baptismum spiritualis propinquitas contrahatur
title.zh: 是否唯有聖洗聖事才結神親

title.la: Utrum cognatio spiritualis contrahatur inter suscipientem sacramentum baptismi et levantem de sacro fonte
title.zh: 受洗的人與那由聖水池中將他提起來的人之間，是否結神親

title.la: Utrum cognatio spiritualis transeat a viro in uxorem
title.zh: 神親是否由丈夫傳給妻子

title.la: Utrum cognatio spiritualis transeat ad filios carnales patris spiritualis
title.zh: 神親是否傳給代父的親生兒子

title.la: De cognatione legali, quae est per adoptionem
title.zh: 論收養關係的法規

title.la: Utrum convenienter adoptio definiatur
title.zh: 收養闊係的定義是否適當

title.la: Utrum ex adoptione contrahatur aliquod vinculum impediens matrimonium
title.zh: 收養關係是否產生婚姻限制

title.la: Utrum talis cognatio non contrahatur nisi inter patrem adoptantem et filium adoptatum
title.zh: 是否只有養父與養子之間有法親

title.la: De impedimentis variis
title.zh: 論性冷感、魔術、瘋癲、親奸和年齡不足的限制

title.la: Utrum frigiditas matrimonium impediat
title.zh: 性冷感是不是婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum maleficium possit matrimonium impedire
title.zh: 魔法是否能成為婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum furia impediat matrimonium
title.zh: 瘋顛是否是婚姻的限制

title.la: Utrum incestus quo quis cognoscit sororem uxoris suae, matrimonium dirimat
title.zh: 丈夫同自己妻於的妹妹犯親姦罪，是否使婚姻無效

title.la: Utrum defectus aetatis impediat matrimonium
title.zh: 年齡不足是否是婚姻的限制

title.la: De disparitate cultus quae matrimonium impediat
title.zh: 論信仰不同的婚姻限制

title.la: Utrum fidelis possit matrimonium cum infideli contrahere
title.zh: 信徒是否能同非信徒結婚

title.la: Utrum inter infideles possit esse matrimonium
title.zh: 非信徒是否能有婚姻

title.la: Utrum coniux conversus ad fidem possit commanere cum uxore infideli nolente converti
title.zh: 皈依信德的丈夫是否能與不願皈依信德的妻子同居共處

title.la: Utrum fidelis conversus possit uxorem infidelem dimittere volentem cohabitare sine contumelia Creatoris
title.zh: 皈依信徒的丈夫是否能休退願意同居共處，而毫不侮辱造物主的非信徒妻子

title.la: Utrum fidelis discedens ab uxore infideli possit aliam ducere in uxorem
title.zh: 離開非信徒妻子的信徒丈夫，是否能娶其他女人為妻

title.la: Utrum alia vitia solvant matrimonium sicut et infidelitas
title.zh: 其它罪過是否像無信德一樣拆散婚姻

title.la: De uxoricidio
title.zh: 論殺妻

title.la: Utrum liceat viro uxorem interficere in actu adulterii deprehensam
title.zh: 丈夫殺害正在通姦的妻子，是不是合法的

title.la: Utrum uxoricidium impediat matrimonium
title.zh: 殺妻是否是婚姻的限制

title.la: De impedimento matrimonii quod est votum solemne
title.zh: 論特級聖願的婚姻限制

title.la: Utrum alter coniugum, etiam post carnalem copulam, possit, altero invito, ad religionem transire
title.zh: 夫妻間房之後，沒有對方的同意，是否能夠進修會

title.la: Utrum alter coniugum, ante carnalem copulam, possit, altero invito, ad religionem transire
title.zh: 夫妻圓房以前，沒有對方的岡意，是否能夠進修會

title.la: Utrum mulier possit nubere alteri, viro ante carnalem copulam religionem ingresso
title.zh: 夫妻國房之前，丈夫進了修會，妻子是否能改嫁他人

title.la: De impedimento quod supervenit matrimonio consummato, quod est fornicatio
title.zh: 論已遂婚姻之後的姦淫限制

title.la: Utrum propter fornicationem liceat viro uxorem dimittere
title.zh: 丈夫因妻子犯姦淫罪而休妻，是不是合法的

title.la: Utrum vir teneatur ex praecepto uxorem fornicantem dimittere
title.zh: 丈夫是否由於命令而該休退犯姦淫罪的妻於

title.la: Utrum proprio iudicio possit vir uxorem fornicantem dimittere
title.zh: 丈夫是否能隨意地休退犯姦淫罪的妻於

title.la: Utrum vir et uxor debeant in causa divortii ad paria iudicari
title.zh: 夫妻的離婚案件是否應該受同等的審判

title.la: Utrum post divortium vir alteri nubere possit
title.zh: 丈夫在離婚以後是否能再娶妻

title.la: Utrum post divortium vir et uxor possint reconciliari
title.zh: 夫妻在離婚以後是否能和好

title.la: De secundis nuptiis
title.zh: 論再婚

title.la: Utrum secundae nuptiae sint licitae
title.zh: 再婚是否合法

title.la: Utrum secundum matrimonium sit sacramentum
title.zh: 再婚是否是準聖事

title.la: De debiti redditione
title.zh: 論與婚姻有關的問題

title.la: Utrum alter coniugum teneatur alteri ad redditionem debiti ex necessitate praecepti
title.zh: 夫妻彼此是否由於法令而應該盡婚姻義務

title.la: Utrum vir teneatur debitum reddere uxori non petenti
title.zh: 丈夫無妻子的要求，是否應該盡婚姻義務

title.la: Utrum liceat mulieri menstruatae debitum a conjugale petere
Utrum debeat sive licite possit mulier menstruata viro poscenti debitum conjugale reddere
Utrum vir et mulier sint in actu matrimoniali aequales
title.zh: 夫妻的房事是否平等

title.la: Utrum vir et uxor possint votum emittere contra debitum matrimonii sine mutuo consensu
title.zh: 夫妻彼此沒有婚姻的合意，是否能發相反婚姻義務的聖願

title.la: Utrum temporibus sacris debeat aliquis impediri quin debitum petat
title.zh: 在聖日是否應該禁止夫妻要求盡婚姻義務

title.la: Utrum petens in tempore sacro mortaliter peccet
title.zh: 夫妻在聖日要求盡婚姻義務，是否犯大罪

title.la: Utrum teneatur reddere tempore festivo
title.zh: 夫妻在教會慶節時，是否應該盡婚姻義務

title.la: Utrum nuptiae certis quibusdam temporibus interdici debeant
De bigamis
title.zh: 論一夫多妻

title.la: Utrum habere plures uxores sit contra legem naturae
title.zh: 男人有許多的妻子是否違反自然律

title.la: Utrum habere plures uxores potuerit aliquando esse licitum
title.zh: 丈夫有許多的妻子是否曾經是合法的

title.la: Utrum habere concubinam sit contra legem naturae
title.zh: 丈夫納妾是否違反自然律

title.la: Utrum accedere ad concubinam sit peccatum mortale
title.zh: 丈夫同妾性交是否是大罪

title.la: Utrum aliquando licitum fuerit concubinam habere
title.zh: 丈夫納妾是否曾經合法

title.la: De bigamia et irregularitate ex ea contracta
title.zh: 論重婚與虧格

title.la: Utrum illi bigamiae quae est ex hoc quod aliquis duas uxores successive habuit, sit irregularitas annexa
title.zh: 虧格是否與人曾連續地娶兩個妻子之重婚有關

title.la: Utrum irregularitas sit annexa bigamiae quae contingit ex hoc quod homo habet duas uxores, simul vel successive, unam de iure, aliam de facto
title.zh: 虧格是否與人同時或連續地娶法律的和實際的妻子之重婚有關

title.la: Utrum contrahatur irregularitas ex hoc quod aliquis ducit uxorem non virginem
title.zh: 人娶非處女為妻是否產生虧格

title.la: Utrum bigamia per baptismum solvatur
title.zh: 重婚是否因聖洗聖事而得解除

title.la: Utrum cum bigamo liceat dispensare
title.zh: 赦免重婚是否合法

title.la: De libello repudii
title.zh: 論休書

title.la: Utrum inseparabilitas uxoris sit de lege naturae
title.zh: 婚姻的不可拆散性是不是屬於自然律

title.la: Utrum uxorem dimittere per dispensationem esse licitum potuerit
title.zh: 寬免休妻是否曾經是合法的

title.la: Utrum sub lege Moysi fuerit licitum uxorem dimittere
title.zh: 在梅瑟法律時代休妻是否合法

title.la: Utram fuerit licitum uxori repudiatae alium virum habere
title.zh: 被休的妻於改嫁是否曾經是合法的

title.la: Utrum fuerit licitum viro repudiatam a se accipere
title.zh: 丈夫再娶自己休退的妻子是否曾經是合法的

title.la: Utrum causa repudii fuerit odium uxoris
title.zh: 休妻的原因是否能是憎恨妻子

title.la: Utrum causae repudii debuerint in libello scribi
title.zh: 休妻的原因是否應該寫在休書上

title.la: De filiis illegitime natis
title.zh: 論私生子女

title.la: Utrum filii qui nascuntur extra verum matrimonium, sint illegitimi
title.zh: 非婚生子女是否是私生的

title.la: Utrum illegitimi filii debeant ex hoc aliquod damnum reportare
title.zh: 私生子女是否應該受損失

title.la: Utrum filius illegitimus possit legitimari
title.zh: 私生子女是否能合法化

title.la: De loco animarum post mortem
title.zh: 論肉身復活的問題：先論人死後靈魂何在

title.la: Utrum animabus post mortem receptacula assignentur
title.zh: 人死後靈魂是否有居所

title.la: Utrum statim post mortem aliquae animae deducantur ad caelos vel ad infernum
title.zh: 人在死後靈魂是否立即昇天堂或下地獄

title.la: Utrum animae in paradiso vel in inferno existentes egredi valeant
title.zh: 住在天堂上或者地獄裡的靈魂，是否能從那裡出來

title.la: Utrum limbus inferni sit idem quod sinus Abrahae
title.zh: 靈薄獄與亞巴郎的懷抱是否相同

title.la: Utrum limbus sit idem quod infernus damnatorum
title.zh: 靈薄獄與惡人所處的地獄是否相同

title.la: Utrum limbus puerorum sit idem quod limbus Patrum
title.zh: 兒童所處的靈薄獄與古聖祖所處的靈薄獄是否相同

title.la: Utrum debeant tot receptacula distingui
title.zh: 是否有許多居所

title.la: De qualitate animae existentis a corpore separatae, et poena ei inflicta ab igne corporeo
title.zh: 論靈魂離開肉身後的性質及其所受的有形火刑

title.la: Utrum in anima separata remaneant potentiae sensitivae
title.zh: 離開肉身後的靈魂，是否仍然有感覺能力

title.la: Utrum in anima separata remaneant actus sensitivarum potentiarum
title.zh: 離開肉身後的靈魂，是否仍然有感覺能力的行為

title.la: Utrum anima separata pati possit ab igne corporeo
title.zh: 離開肉身後的靈魂，是否可能受有形的火刑

title.la: De suffragiis mortuorum
title.zh: 論生者對亡者靈魂的救助

title.la: Utrum suffragia per unum facta alii prodesse possint
title.zh: 一人所奉獻的救助是否有益於另一人

title.la: Utrum mortui possint iuvari ex operibus vivorum
title.zh: 生者的善工是否可能救助亡者

title.la: Utrum suffragia facta per peccatores mortuis prosint
title.zh: 罪人所奉獻的救助是否有益於亡者

title.la: Utrum suffragia quae a vivis pro mortuis fiunt, facientibus prosint
title.zh: 生者為亡者奉獻的救助，是否有益於活人

title.la: Utrum suffragia prosint existentibus in inferno
title.zh: 生者為亡者奉獻的救助，是否有錢於地獄的惡人

title.la: Utrum suffragia prosint existentibus in purgatorio
title.zh: 生者為亡者奉獻的救助，是否有益於煉獄靈魂

title.la: Utrum suffragia valeant pueris in limbo existentibus
title.zh: 生者為亡者奉獻的救助，是否有益於璽薄獄的兒童

title.la: Utrum suffragia aliquo modo prosint sanctis existentibus in patria
title.zh: 生者為亡者奉獻的救助，是否有益於天堂的聖人

title.la: Utrum solum orationibus Ecclesiae, et Sacrificio Altaris, et eleemosynis animae defunctorum iuventur
title.zh: 是否唯有聖教會的祈禱、彌撒聖祭和哀矜，纔可能、或者特殊地救助亡者靈魂

title.la: Utrum indulgentiae quas Ecclesia facit, etiam mortuis prosint
title.zh: 聖教會所頒的大赦是否有益於亡者

title.la: Utrum cultus exequiarum defuncto prosit
title.zh: 葬禮是否有位於亡者有關第十-節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum suffragia quae fiunt pro uno defuncto, magis proficiant ei pro quo fiunt quam aliis
title.zh: 生者為一位亡者奉獻的救助，是否也有益於其他亡者

title.la: An suffragia facta pro multis tantundem valeant singulis ac si pro unoquoque specialiter fierent
title.zh: 生者為許多亡者奉獻的救助，是否像專為一人般地有效

title.la: Utrum tantum valeant communia suffragia illis pro quibus specialia non fiunt, quantum illis pro quibus fiunt valent specialia et communia simul
title.zh: 生者只為亡者奉獻公共救助，與同時奉獻公共救助及特殊救助，效力是否相同

title.la: De oratione sanctorum qui sunt in patria
title.zh: 論天堂聖人的祈禱

title.la: Utrum sancti orationes nostras cognoscant
title.zh: 天堂的聖人是否知道我們的祈禱

title.la: Utrum debeamus sanctos interpellare ad orandum pro nobis
title.zh: 是否應該祈求天堂的聖人為我們轉求天主

title.la: Utrum orationes sanctorum ad Deum pro nobis fusae semper exaudiantur
title.zh: 天堂聖人的轉求是否常蒙天主的允

title.la: De signis quae iudicium praecedent
title.zh: 論公審判前的異兆

title.la: Utrum adventum Domini ad iudicium praecessura sint aliqua signa
title.zh: 主的公審判來臨前，是否將有異兆出現

title.la: Utrum circa iudicium secundum rei veritatem sol et luna obscurandi sint
title.zh: H丹在公審判時，是否將真正失光

title.la: Utrum virtutes caelorum, Domino veniente, commovendae sint
title.zh: 當主再來時，天上的德、能者是否會動搖

title.la: De igne ultimae conflagrationis
title.zh: 論最後焚燬世界的烈火

title.la: Utrum aliqua mundi purgatio sit futura
title.zh: 世界是否將有淨化

title.la: Utrum haec purgatio sit futura per ignem
title.zh: 未來的淨化是否用火

title.la: Utrum ille ignis sit eiusdem speciei cum igne elementari
title.zh: 這種烈火是否與元素之火同類

title.la: Utrum ignis ille purgaturus sit etiam caelos superiores
title.zh: 這種烈火是否也將淨化高天

title.la: Utrum ignis ille alia elementa consumpturus sit
title.zh: 這種烈火是否將焚毀其它元素

title.la: Utrum omnia elementa per illum ignem purganda sint
title.zh: 這種烈火是否應該淨化一切元素

title.la: Utrum ignis ultimae conflagrationis iudicium debeat sequi
title.zh: 最後焚毀世界的烈火是否應該在公審判之後

title.la: Utrum ille ignis habiturus sit talem effectum in hominibus qualis designatur
title.zh: 這種烈火是否將對人類產生所敘述的效果

title.la: Utrum ille ignis involuturus sit reprobos
title.zh: 這種烈火是否將席捲一切惡人

title.la: De resurrectione
title.zh: 論肉身復活

title.la: Utrum corporum resurrectio sit futura
title.zh: 是否將有肉身復活

title.la: Utrum resurrectio sit futura omnium generaliter
title.zh: 全人類的肉身是否都將復活

title.la: Utrum resurrectio sit naturalis
title.zh: 肉身復活是否是自然的有關第三郎，我們討論如下:

title.la: De causa resurrectionis
title.zh: 論肉身復活的原因

title.la: Utrum Christi resurrectio sit causa nostrae resurrectionis
title.zh: 基督的復活是否是我們肉身復活的原因

title.la: Utrum vox tubae sit causa nostrae resurrectionis
title.zh: 天主的號角聲是否是我們肉身復活的原因

title.la: Utrum aliquo modo ad resurrectionem angeli operaturi sint
title.zh: 天使為肉身復活是否也將有所作為

title.la: De tempore et modo resurrectionis
title.zh: 論肉身復活的時間與方式

title.la: Utrum tempus resurrectionis oporteat differri usque ad finem mundi
title.zh: 肉身復活的時間是否應該延至世界末日

title.la: Utrum tempus resurrectionis illud sit occultum
title.zh: 肉身復活的時間是否祕而不宣

title.la: Utrum resurrectio futura sit in noctis tempore
title.zh: 未來的肉身復活是否在夜間

title.la: Utrum resurrectio futura sit subito vel successive
title.zh: 未來的肉身復活是否是立即的，或者是逐漸的

title.la: De termino resurrectionis
title.zh: 論肉身復活的起點

title.la: Utrum mors sit futura terminus a quo resurrectionis in omnibus
title.zh: 死亡是否是所有人肉身復活的起點

title.la: Utrum omnium resurrectio futura sit a cineribus
title.zh: 全人類是否都將從灰燼中復活

title.la: Utrum pulveres illi ex quibus humanum corpus reparabitur, aliquam habeant inclinationem naturalem ad animam quae eis coniungetur
title.zh: 重塑人類身體的灰燼'是否自然地傾向使它們凝聚的靈魂有關第三郎，我們討論如下:

title.la: De conditionibus resurgentium et, primo, de eorum identitate
title.zh: 論死人復活後的同一性

title.la: Utrum idem corpus numero anima resumptura sit in resurrectione
title.zh: 復活者的軍魂是否將與同一肉身重新合一

title.la: Utrum sit futurus idem numero homo qui resurget
title.zh: 未來復活的是否是同一個人

title.la: Utrum oporteat pulveres humani corporis ad eam partem corporis quae in eis dissoluta est, per resurrectionem redire
title.zh: 在肉身復活時，已化為灰燼的人類身體，是否必須再回復成原先的肢體部位

title.la: De integritate corporum resurgentium
title.zh: 論復活身體的完整

title.la: Utrum omnia membra corporis humani resurrectura sint
title.zh: 人類身體的一切肢體是否都將復活

title.la: Utrum capilli et ungues resurrecturi sint in homine
title.zh: 人的頭髮與指甲是否將復活

title.la: Utrum humores in corpore resurrecturi sint
title.zh: 人的體液是否復活

title.la: Utrum totum quod fuit in corpore de veritate humanae naturae, resurrecturum sit in ipso
title.zh: 凡真實屬於人性的一切，是否都將隨著肉身而復活

title.la: Utrum quidquid fuit materialiter in membris hominis, totum resurrecturum sit
title.zh: 所有人類肢體的物質成份，是否都將復活

title.la: De qualitate resurgentium
title.zh: 論復活者之身體的性質

title.la: Utrum omnes resurrecturi sint in eadem aetate, scilicet iuvenili
title.zh: 所有的人是否都復活成同樣的青春年紀

title.la: Utrum omnes resurrecturi sint eiusdem staturae
title.zh: 復活者是否都成為同等身材

title.la: Utrum omnes resurrecturi sint in sexu virili
title.zh: 復活者是否都成為同一性別，即男性

title.la: Utrum resurrecturi sint in vita animali, ut scilicet utantur actu nutritivae et generativae
title.zh: 復活者是否都度生養的動物性生活

title.la: De conditionibus beatorum resurgentium
title.zh: 論聖人們復活後的情況

title.la: Utrum corpora sanctorum post resurrectionem futura sint impassibilia
title.zh: 未來聖人們復活後的身體是不是神健的

title.la: Utrum impassibilitas in omnibus futura sit aequalis
title.zh: 一切聖人們的神健是否相等

title.la: Utrum impassibilitas sensum in actu a corporibus gloriosis excludat
title.zh: 光榮身體的神健是否排除現實的感覺

title.la: Utrum futuri sint ibi omnes sensus in actu
title.zh: 未來聖人們在天堂上的感覺是否都是現實的

title.la: De subtilitate corporum beatorum
title.zh: 論聖人肉身復活後的神透

title.la: Utrum subtilitas sit proprietas corporis gloriosi
title.zh: 神透是不是光榮身體的特性

title.la: Utrum ratione huius subtilitatis competat coprori glorioso esse in eodem loco cum alio corpore non glorioso
title.zh: 光榮的身體因神透，是否能與非光榮的身體同時存在於同一個地方

title.la: Utrum per miraculum fieri possit quod duo corpora sint in eodem loco
title.zh: 兩個物體藉著奇蹟，是否能同時存在於同一個地方

title.la: Utrum corpus gloriosum possit esse cum alio glorioso in eodem loco
title.zh: 光榮的身體是否能與其它的光榮身體，同時存在於同一個地方

title.la: Utrum ex sua subtilitate removeatur a corpore glorioso necessitas existendi in aequali loco
title.zh: 光榮的身體困神透，是否不必存在於相等的地方

title.la: Utrum corpus gloriosum ratione subtilitatis sit impalpabile
title.zh: 光榮的身體因神透，是否不可捉摸

title.la: De agilitate beatorum corporum resurgentium
title.zh: 論聖人身體復活後的神速

title.la: Utrum corpora gloriosa sint futura agilia
title.zh: 光榮身體是不是神速的

title.la: Utrum agilitate sua aliquando usura sint ita quod moveantur
title.zh: 聖人的神速是否用於運動

title.la: Utrum moveantur in instanti
title.zh: 聖人的運動是否是立即的

title.la: De claritate corporum beatorum
title.zh: 論聖人身體復活後的神光

title.la: Utrum corporibus gloriosis claritas conveniat
title.zh: 神光是否屬於光榮的身體

title.la: Utrum claritas corporis gloriosi possit videri ab oculo non glorioso
title.zh: 非光榮身體的眼睛是否能看見光榮身體的神光

title.la: Utrum corpus gloriosum necessario videatur a corpore non glorioso
title.zh: 非光榮的身體是否必然地看見光漿的身體

title.la: De conditionibus corporum damnatorum resurgentium
title.zh: 論惡人的身體復活後所有的情況

title.la: Utrum corpora damnatorum cum suis deformitatibus resurrectura sint
title.zh: 未來惡人的身體是否將帶著自己的畸形一起復活

title.la: Utrum corpora damnatorum futura sint incorruptibilia
title.zh: 未來惡人的身體是否是不朽的

title.la: Utrum corpora damnati sint impassibilia
title.zh: 未來惡人的身體是否是神健的

title.la: De cognitione quam habebunt resuscitati in iudicio respectu meritorum et demeritorum
title.zh: 論復活者在公審判時對功過所有的知識

title.la: Utrum post resurrectionem cogniturus sit quilibet omnia peccata quae fecit
title.zh: 復活後的人是否將知道自己所犯的一切罪過

title.la: Utrum quilibet potens futurus sit legere omnia quae sunt in conscientia alterius
title.zh: 復活後的人是否能知道他人良心所有的一切

title.la: Utrum omnia merita vel demerita propria et aliena ab aliquo uno intuitu videnda sint
title.zh: 復活後的人是否都因唯一的直觀而知道功過

title.la: De iudicio generali, tempore et loco in quo fiet
title.zh: 論公審判的時間與地方

title.la: Utrum generale iudicium sit futurum
title.zh: 是否將有公審判

title.la: Utrum iudicium illud, quantum ad disceptationem et sententiam, faciendum sit per locutionem vocalem
title.zh: 公審判的宣判是否該月1言語

title.la: Utrum tempus futuri iudicii sit ignotum
title.zh: 公審判的時間是否無人得知

title.la: Utrum iudicium faciendum sit in valle Iosaphat, aut in loco circumstante
title.zh: 公審判是否應該在約沙法特山谷或其周圍的地方舉行

title.la: De iudicantibus et iudicatis in iudicio generali
title.zh: 論公審判的審判者與受審判者

title.la: Utrum aliqui homines iudicaturi sint cum Christo
title.zh: 是否有些人將向基督一起審判全人類

title.la: Utrum iudiciaria potestas correspondeat voluntariae paupertati
title.zh: 審判權是否與神貧相符合

title.la: Utrum angeli debeant iudicare
title.zh: 天使是否應該審判全人類

title.la: Utrum post diem iudicii daemones executuri sint sententiam Iudicis in damnatis
title.zh: 魔鬼在公審判後，是否將執行審判官對惑人的判決

title.la: Utrum omnes homines in iudicio comparituri sint
title.zh: 全人類在公審判時，是否都將出庭受審判

title.la: Utrum boni in iudicio iudicandi sint
title.zh: 善人在公審判時是否將受審判

title.la: Utrum mali iudicandi sint
title.zh: 惡人在公審判時是否將受審判

title.la: Utrum angeli in futuro iudicandi sint
title.zh: 天使在公審判時是否將受審判

title.la: De forma iudicis venientis ad iudicium
title.zh: 論審判官降來審判時的形體

title.la: Utrum Christus in forma servi sit iudicaturus
title.zh: 基督是否將以奴僕的形體降來而審判

title.la: Utrum Christus in iudicio appariturus sit in forma humanitatis gloriosa
title.zh: 基督在公審判時，是否將以光榮的人類形體顯現

title.la: Utrum divinitas a malis sine gaudio videri possit
title.zh: 惡人是否可能享見基督的天主性而不感到快樂

title.la: De qualitate mundi et resurgentium post iudicium
title.zh: 論神界復活者在公審判後的情況

title.la: Utrum mundus innovandus sit
title.zh: 世界是否將煥然一新

title.la: Utrum motus corporum caelestium in illa mundi innovatione cessaturus sit
title.zh: 天體的運行在煥然一新的世界上，是否將停止

title.la: Utrum in corporibus caelestibus claritas augenda sit in illa innovatione
title.zh: 天體的光輝在煥然一新的世界上，是否將增加

title.la: Utrum elementa innovanda sint per receptionem alicuius claritatis
title.zh: 元素是否因增加光輝而將煥然一新

title.la: Utrum plantae et alia animalia remansura sint in illa innovatione
title.zh: 動植物在煥然一新的世界上，是否仍將存在

title.la: De visione divinae essentiae per comparationem ad beatos
title.zh: 論聖人享見天主的本體

title.la: Utrum intellectus humanus possit pervenire ad videndum Deum per essentiam
title.zh: 人類的理智是否可能享見天主的本體

title.la: Utrum sancti post resurrectionem Deum corporalibus oculis visuri sint
title.zh: 聖人復活後的肉眼是否將享見天主

title.la: Utrum sancti videntes Deum per essentiam omnia videant quae Deus in seipso videt
title.zh: 享見天主的聖人，是否都享見天主所見的萬物

title.la: De sanctorum beatitudine et eorum mansionibus
title.zh: 論聖人的真福與住處

title.la: Utrum beatitudo sanctorum sit maior futura post iudicium quam ante
title.zh: 聖人在公審判後的未來真福。是否大於在公審判前的真褔

title.la: Utrum beatitudinis gradus mansiones dici debeant
title.zh: 真褔的等級是否應該稱為住處

title.la: Utrum diversae mansiones distinguantur penes diversos gradus caritatis
title.zh: 不同的住處是否按愛德等級區分

title.la: De modo quo se sancti habebunt erga damnatos
title.zh: 論聖人與惡人的關係

title.la: Utrum beati qui erunt in patria, visuri sint poenas damnatorum
title.zh: 天堂的聖人是否將看見惡人受的刑罰

title.la: Utrum beati miseriis damnatorum compatiantur
title.zh: 天堂的聖人是否同情惡人的不幸

title.la: Utrum beati laetentur de poenis impiorum
title.zh: 天堂的聖人是否喜樂於惡人的刑罰

title.la: De dotibus beatorum
title.zh: 論聖人的奇恩

title.la: Utrum ponendae sint aliquae dotes in hominibus beatis
title.zh: 聖人是否得到一些作為贈禮的奇恩

title.la: Utrum dos sit idem quod beatitudo
title.zh: 作為妝宮的奇恩是否與真福相同

title.la: Utrum Christo competat habere dotes
title.zh: 基督是否適宜有一些作為妝盔的奇恩

title.la: Utrum angeli habeant dotes
title.zh: 天使是否有一些作為妝富的奇恩

title.la: Utrum convenienter ponantur tres esse animae dotes: scilicet visio, dilectio et fruitio
title.zh: 靈魂是否適宜有三種作為妝富的奇恩，即是:享見、愛慕和享有天主

title.la: De aureolis
title.zh: 論聖人的大光圈

title.la: Utrum aureola sit aliquod aliud praemium a praemio essentiali, quod aurea dicitur
title.zh: 大光圈與所講的小光圈之基本賞報是否相同

title.la: Utrum aureola differat a fructu
title.zh: 大光國與果實是否有別

title.la: Utrum fructus debeatur soli virtuti continentiae
title.zh: 果實是否只應該歸於節慾之德

title.la: Utrum convenienter assignentur tres fructus tribus continentiae partibus
title.zh: 三種效果是否適宜歸於節慾之德的三部分

title.la: Utrum ratione virginitatis debeatur aureola
title.zh: 大光圈是否應該歸於貞操

title.la: Utrum martyribus aureola debeatur
title.zh: 大光圈是否應該歸於殉道烈士有關這一節，我們討論如下:

title.la: Utrum doctoribus aureola debeatur
title.zh: 大光園是否應該歸於聖師

title.la: Utrum Christo aureola debeatur
title.zh: 大光圈是否應該歸於基督

title.la: Utrum angelis aureola debeatur
title.zh: 大光圈是否應該歸於天使

title.la: Utrum aureola etiam corpori debeatur
title.zh: 大光圈是否也應該歸於肉身

title.la: Utrum convenienter designentur tres aureolae, virginum, martyrum et praedicatorum
title.zh: 大光園是否適宜分為貞女、殉道烈士和聖師三項

title.la: Utrum aureola virginum sit inter alias potissima
title.zh: 貞女的大光圈是否是大光圈中最大者

title.la: Utrum unus aureolam virginitatis vel martyrii vel doctoris excellentius alio habeat
title.zh: 某位貞女、殉道烈士或者聖師的大光圈，是否優於其他人的大光圈

title.la: De poena damnatorum
title.zh: 論惡人在公審判後所受的刑罰

title.la: Utrum damnati in inferno sola poena ignis affligantur
title.zh: 地獄的惡人是否只受火刑

title.la: Utrum vermis quo affliguntur damnati, sit vermis corporalis
title.zh: 使惡人受苦的晶子是否是肉身的

title.la: Utrum fletus qui erit in damnatis, futurus sit corporalis
title.zh: 未來惡人的哀號是否是肉身的

title.la: Utrum damnati futuri sint in tenebris corporalibus
title.zh: 未來惡人是否住在有形的黑暗中

title.la: Utrum ignis inferni, quo cruciabuntur corpora damnatorum, sit corporeus
title.zh: 地獄懲罰惡人身體的烈火是否是有形的

title.la: Utrum ignis ille sit eiusdem speciei cum igne isto corporeo quem videmus
title.zh: 地獄的烈火與人所看見的有形烈火，種類是否相同

title.la: Utrum ignis ille sit sub terra
title.zh: 地獄的烈火是否是在地下

title.la: De voluntate et intellectu damnatorum
title.zh: 論惡人的意志與理智

title.la: Utrum omnis voluntas damnatorum sit mala
title.zh: 惡人的整個意志是否都是邪惡的

title.la: Utrum damnati poeniteant de malis quae fecerunt
title.zh: 惡人是否懊悔自己所犯的罪過

title.la: Utrum damnati recta ratione et deliberativa possint velle se non esse
title.zh: 惡人是否能因正當與慎重的理由而渴望不存在

title.la: Utrum damnati in inferno vellent alios esse damnatos qui non sunt damnati
title.zh: 地獄中的惡人是否渴望那些沒有受罰的人們受罰

title.la: Utrum damnati habeant Deum odio
title.zh: 惡人是否惱恨天主

title.la: Utrum damnati demereantur
title.zh: 受永罰的惡人是否繼續犯罪

title.la: Utrum damnati possint uti notitia quam in hoc mundo habuerunt
title.zh: 惡人是否能運用自己在現世所求得的知識

title.la: Utrum damnati cogitaturi sint de Deo
title.zh: 惡人是否將想起天主

title.la: Utrum damnati gloriam beatorum videant
title.zh: 惡人是否看到聖人的光榮

title.la: De misericordia et iustitia Dei respectu damnatorum
title.zh: 天主對惡人的正義與仁慈

title.la: Utrum ex divina iustitia inferatur peccatoribus poena aeterna
title.zh: 罪人是否因天主的正義而受永罰

title.la: Utrum per divinam misericordiam omnis poena terminetur tam hominum quam etiam daemonum
title.zh: 惡人與魔鬼的一切刑罰，是否因天主的仁慈而結束

title.la: Utrum divina misericordia patiatur homines in aeternum puniri
title.zh: 天主的仁慈是否容許世人受永罰

title.la: Utrum Christianorum poena per divinam misericordiam terminetur
title.zh: 至少基督徒的刑罰，是否因天主的仁慈而結束

title.la: Utrum illi qui opera misericordiae faciunt, puniantur aeternaliter: vel solum illi qui opera misericordiae negligunt
title.zh: 行仁愛善工者，是否將受永罰;或者唯有輕視仁愛善工者，才將受永罰

title.la: Appendices
title.zh: 補編附錄

title.la: De purgatorio
title.zh: 論煉獄

title.la: Utrum purgatorium sit post hanc vitam
title.zh: 在今生之後是否有煉獄

title.la: Utrum sit idem locus quo animae purgantur, et quo damnati puniuntur
title.zh: 煉淨中的靈魂與惡人受永罰的地方是否相同

title.la: Utrum poena purgatorii excedat omnem poenam temporalem huius vitae
title.zh: 煉獄的刑罰是否超越現世的一切暫罰

title.la: Utrum illa poena sit voluntaria
title.zh: 煉獄的刑罰是否是自願的

title.la: Utrum animae in purgatorio per daemones puniantur
title.zh: 煉獄中的靈魂是否受魔鬼折磨

title.la: Utrum per poenam purgatorii expietur peccatum veniale quoad culpam
title.zh: 煉獄的刑罰是否補贖小罪

title.la: Utrum ignis purgatorius liberet a reatu poenae
title.zh: 煉獄的烈火是否赦免罪罰

title.la: Utrum ab illa poena unus liberetur alio citius
title.zh: 相同的罪罰，這人是否能比那人更快地得赦

title.la: De poena originalis peccati
title.zh: 論原罪的刑罰

title.la: Utrum peccato originali secundum se debeatur poena sensibilis
title.zh: 覺苦是否應該歸於死去時只帶有原罪的人

title.la: Utrum pueri non baptizati afflictionem spiritualem in anima sentiant
title.zh: 未受洗的兒童靈魂，是否感受到精神的痛苦

proofreading.scope: 逐處核對後的初修，並非全書逐字校畢
proofreading.policy: 僅修復掃描影像可確認的OCR錯誤、漏文與段落錯位；不潤色、不改寫、不由拉丁文補譯。

punctuation_revision.scope: 中文引號與書名號OCR專項修復（含目錄與內置文本）
punctuation_revision.policy: 依可辨識的標點形狀與上下文修復；嚴重亂碼留待原頁核對。
